title.zh: 印度佛教通过海上商路向东南亚传播

summary.zh: 公元2世纪起，印度佛教僧侣随商船前往东南亚，在缅甸、泰国、柬埔寨等地建立佛教寺院。贵霜帝国（Kushan Empire）境内的犍陀罗地区（今巴基斯坦北部）形成了融合希腊艺术风格的佛教造像艺术，这种艺术随着佛教传播影响了整个东亚。

statement.zh: 公元2世纪起，印度佛教僧侣随商船前往东南亚，在缅甸、泰国、柬埔寨等地建立佛教寺院。
statement.en: From the 2nd century AD, Indian Buddhist monks traveled with merchant ships to Southeast Asia, establishing monasteries in Burma, Thailand, Cambodia, etc.

zh: 公元2世纪起，印度佛教僧侣随商船前往东南亚，在缅甸、泰国、柬埔寨等地建立佛教寺院。
en: From the 2nd century AD, Indian Buddhist monks traveled with merchant ships to Southeast Asia, establishing monasteries in Burma, Thailand, Cambodia, etc.

statement.en: In the Kushan Empire, the Gandhara region (modern northern Pakistan) developed Buddhist iconography blending Greek artistic styles, which influenced all of East Asia as Buddhism spread.

title.zh: 曹操在官渡之战后乘胜追击，逐步平定河北

summary.zh: 公元200年曹操在官渡大败袁绍主力，至201年曹操乘胜渡过黄河，进攻袁绍据守的仓亭（今山东阳谷），再次击败袁绍军。袁绍退回邺城，不久病重。曹操控制了黄河中下游大部分地区，为统一北方奠定基础。

statement.zh: 把官渡当成一次性决战，会忽略后面近十年的战争与招降。
statement.en: Treating Guandu as a single decisive battle ignores the near decade of fighting and surrender that followed.

zh: 把官渡当成一次性决战，会忽略后面近十年的战争与招降。
en: Treating Guandu as a single decisive battle ignores the near decade of fighting and surrender that followed.

statement.zh: 官渡之后，曹操渡河追击，在仓亭再败袁绍。
statement.en: After Guandu, Cao Cao crossed the Yellow River and defeated Yuan Shao again at Cangting.

zh: 官渡之后，曹操渡河追击，在仓亭再败袁绍。
en: After Guandu, Cao Cao crossed the Yellow River and defeated Yuan Shao again at Cangting.

statement.zh: 袁绍退回邺城，河北仍未平定；曹操也没有立刻渡河北上，而是先巩固兖、豫、徐。
statement.en: Yuan retreated to Ye, but Hebei was not yet pacified, and Cao did not immediately move north; he first consolidated Yan, Yu and Xu.

zh: 袁绍退回邺城，河北仍未平定；曹操也没有立刻渡河北上，而是先巩固兖、豫、徐。
en: Yuan retreated to Ye, but Hebei was not yet pacified, and Cao did not immediately move north; he first consolidated Yan, Yu and Xu.

statement.zh: 所谓“统一北方”是逐步完成的：先取冀州，再平幽州、并州，最后远征乌桓。
statement.en: 'Unifying the north' was a gradual process: Ji first, then You and Bing, and finally the Wuhuan campaign.

zh: 所谓“统一北方”是逐步完成的：先取冀州，再平幽州、并州，最后远征乌桓。
en: 'Unifying the north' was a gradual process: Ji first, then You and Bing, and finally the Wuhuan campaign.

title.zh: 马克里努斯被东方军队拥立为罗马皇帝

summary.zh: 卡拉卡拉被杀后，马克里努斯在军队的支持下成为罗马帝国第一位非元老出身的皇帝。他迅速与帕提亚议和，结束了卡拉卡拉发动的战争，但这一和平政策使得渴望战利品的军团士兵极度不满。

statement.zh: 卡拉卡拉被杀后，马克里努斯在军队的支持下成为罗马帝国第一位非元老出身的皇帝。
statement.en: After Caracalla's assassination, Macrinus became the first Roman emperor not of senatorial origin, backed by the army.

title.zh: 罗马帝国民众起义导致马克里努斯改革商业税

summary.zh: 马克里努斯在刺杀卡拉卡拉后继位为罗马皇帝，但他出身骑士阶级，元老院对他并不尊重。为解决财政危机，他削减军饷，导致军队不满；同时他改革商业税制，提高关税，引发了东方行省商人的反抗。

statement.zh: 马克里努斯在刺杀卡拉卡拉后继位为罗马皇帝，但他出身骑士阶级，元老院对他并不尊重。
statement.en: Macrinus succeeded Caracalla as Roman emperor, but as a knight-class emperor he commanded little respect from the Senate.

title.zh: 曹操进攻黎阳，袁绍病逝后诸子内讧

summary.zh: 袁绍于202年夏病逝于邺城，其子袁谭、袁尚为争夺继承权发生内讧。曹操乘机北上攻打黎阳（今河南浚县），袁尚率军救援，被曹操击败。曹操并未强攻邺城，而是坐观袁氏兄弟相争，为日后彻底消灭袁氏势力埋下伏笔。

statement.zh: 袁绍于202年夏病逝于邺城，其子袁谭、袁尚为争夺继承权发生内讧。曹操乘机北上攻打黎阳（今河南浚县），袁尚率军救援，被曹操击败。曹操并未强攻邺城，而是坐观袁氏兄弟相争，为日后彻底消灭袁氏势力埋下伏笔。
statement.en:
Yuan Shao died of illness in Yecheng in summer 202. His sons Yuan Tan and Yuan Shang fought over succession. Cao Cao took the opportunity to march north and attack Liyang (modern Xun County, Henan). Yuan Shang led troops to relieve the siege but was defeated. Cao Cao did not storm Yecheng but sat back to watch the brothers fight, setting the stage for their eventual destruction.

For Asia in 202 CE, “Cao Cao attacks Liyang; after Yuan Shao's death, his sons fall into infighting” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

zh: 袁绍于202年夏病逝于邺城，其子袁谭、袁尚为争夺继承权发生内讧。曹操乘机北上攻打黎阳（今河南浚县），袁尚率军救援，被曹操击败。曹操并未强攻邺城，而是坐观袁氏兄弟相争，为日后彻底消灭袁氏势力埋下伏笔。
袁绍于202年夏病逝于邺城，其子袁谭、袁尚为争夺继承权发生内讧。
en: Yuan Shao died of illness in Yecheng in summer 202. His sons Yuan Tan and Yuan Shang fought over succession. Cao Cao took the opportunity to march north and attack Liyang (modern Xun County, Henan). Yuan Shang led troops to relieve the siege but was defeated. Cao Cao did not storm Yecheng but sat back to watch the brothers fight, setting the stage for their eventual destruction.
Yuan Shao died of illness in Yecheng in summer 202.

title.zh: 袁绍病逝，袁谭与袁尚争夺继承权

summary.zh: 冀州霸主袁绍因官渡惨败而郁郁成疾，于202年5月病逝于邺城。他生前宠爱幼子袁尚，命其继承家业，但长子袁谭不服，联合袁熙、高干等势力与袁尚对抗。袁谭屯兵黎阳，袁尚派兵增援，兄弟相争给了曹操可乘之机。

statement.zh: 袁绍死后，袁尚继承冀州，袁谭不服，兄弟各自结盟，河北分裂。
statement.en: After Yuan Shao's death, Yuan Shang inherited Ji Province, Yuan Tan refused to accept it, and the brothers built separate alliances.

zh: 袁绍死后，袁尚继承冀州，袁谭不服，兄弟各自结盟，河北分裂。
en: After Yuan Shao's death, Yuan Shang inherited Ji Province, Yuan Tan refused to accept it, and the brothers built separate alliances.

statement.zh: 曹操没有立即强攻，而是先南征刘表、刘备，再回师河北，利用袁氏内斗逐个击破。
statement.en: Cao Cao did not attack immediately; he campaigned south against Liu Biao and Liu Bei, then returned to exploit the Yuan feud.

zh: 曹操没有立即强攻，而是先南征刘表、刘备，再回师河北，利用袁氏内斗逐个击破。
en: Cao Cao did not attack immediately; he campaigned south against Liu Biao and Liu Bei, then returned to exploit the Yuan feud.

statement.zh: 袁谭甚至一度向曹操求援，曹操借机进入邺城。
statement.en: Yuan Tan even asked Cao for help, and Cao used the invitation to enter Ye.

zh: 袁谭甚至一度向曹操求援，曹操借机进入邺城。
en: Yuan Tan even asked Cao for help, and Cao used the invitation to enter Ye.

statement.zh: 继承制度不清、诸子各拥兵，是袁氏失败的关键；官渡的军事失败只是把政治裂痕提前暴露。
statement.en: Unclear succession and sons with their own armies were the real weakness of the Yuan house; Guandu merely exposed the political fracture earlier.

title.zh: 罗马皇帝卡拉卡拉被禁卫军长官马克里努斯刺杀

summary.zh: 罗马皇帝卡拉卡拉在远征帕提亚途中，于卡莱（今土耳其南部）附近被自己的禁卫军长官马克里努斯（Macrinus）派刺客杀死。卡拉卡拉以暴政著称，曾屠杀数千名亚历山大城的居民，并将罗马公民权授予所有自由民（212年《安东尼努斯敕令》）以增加税收。他的死导致塞维鲁王朝终结。

statement.en: During a campaign against Parthia, Roman emperor Caracalla was killed by assassins sent by his Praetorian prefect Macrinus near Carrhae (modern southern Turkey).

title.zh: 曹操攻破黎阳，彻底控制黄河以北

summary.zh: 曹操趁袁谭与袁尚内斗，再次发兵北上。袁谭不敌，求救于袁尚；袁尚率军救援，双方在黎阳城下激战。曹操大破袁军，袁谭、袁尚败退邺城。曹操并未追击，而是回军许都，以汉献帝名义封袁谭为青州刺史，进一步分化袁氏兄弟。

title.zh: 罗马皇帝塞维鲁改革禁卫军，扩大蛮族招募

summary.zh: 罗马皇帝塞普提米乌斯·塞维鲁（Septimius Severus）为巩固权力，解散了原有的禁卫军，从自己麾下的多瑙河军团中选拔精锐组建新的禁卫军，并允许士兵在服役期间结婚。他还大量招募日耳曼人和伊利里亚人等蛮族进入军队，导致罗马军队日益蛮族化。

statement.en: To consolidate power, Roman emperor Septimius Severus disbanded the existing Praetorian Guard and formed a new one from elite soldiers of his Danubian legions, allowing soldiers to marry during service.

title.zh: 高卢行省罗马化进程持续，基督教在南高卢城市传播

summary.zh: 高卢行省（今法国地区）经过两个世纪的罗马统治，贵族阶层已完全接受拉丁语言、罗马法律和生活方式。里昂、纳博讷、阿尔勒等城市遍布罗马式剧院、浴场和高架水道。基督教经由商人从叙利亚传入，在里昂形成教团，圣爱任纽（Irenaeus）曾在里昂主教任上著书反驳诺斯替主义。

title.zh: 埃及基督教学派——亚历山大里亚教理学校繁荣

summary.zh: 罗马帝国埃及行省的亚历山大里亚城不仅是学术中心，也是基督教学术重镇。教理学校（Catechetical School）培养了大量神学家，如克莱门特（Clement）和奥利金（Origen，约184-253年）。奥利金在此撰写了《六文本合参》和《原道》，将希腊哲学与基督教神学结合，影响了后世基督教思想。

title.zh: 罗马帝国在塞维鲁王朝统治下遭遇贸易衰退与通货膨胀

summary.zh: 塞维鲁为犒赏军队大幅提高军饷，导致银币含银量从卡拉卡拉时期的50%降至40%，物价飞涨。同时，帝国东部边境与帕提亚的战争破坏了丝绸之路贸易，地中海海盗活动因海军经费不足而日益猖獗，跨行省商品流通受阻。这些经济问题预告了3世纪危机的到来。

title.zh: 叙利亚少年埃拉伽巴路斯被其祖母拥立为罗马皇帝

summary.zh: 马克里努斯皇帝因财政紧缩失去民心，塞维鲁王朝遗孀朱莉娅·梅萨（Julia Maesa）在叙利亚拥立其14岁的外孙埃拉伽巴路斯（Elagabalus）为帝，宣称他是卡拉卡拉的儿子。东方的军团倒戈，马克里努斯在安条克战役中战败逃亡，于卡帕多西亚被处决。埃拉伽巴路斯成为罗马皇帝，将东方太阳神崇拜强加于罗马。

statement.zh: 马克里努斯皇帝因财政紧缩失去民心，塞维鲁王朝遗孀朱莉娅·梅萨（Julia Maesa）在叙利亚拥立其14岁的外孙埃拉伽巴路斯（Elagabalus）为帝，宣称他是卡拉卡拉的儿子。东方的军团倒戈，马克里努斯在安条克战役中战败逃亡，于卡帕多西亚被处决。埃拉伽巴路斯成为罗马皇帝，将东方太阳神崇拜强加于罗马。
statement.en:
Emperor Macrinus lost popular support due to fiscal austerity. Julia Maesa, widow of the Severan dynasty, proclaimed her 14‑year‑old grandson Elagabalus as emperor in Syria, claiming he was Caracalla's son. Eastern legions defected; Macrinus was defeated at the Battle of Antioch, fled, and was executed in Cappadocia. Elagabalus became emperor and imposed the worship of the Syrian sun god on Rome.

For Europe in 205 CE, “Syrian teenager Elagabalus proclaimed Roman emperor by his grandmother” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 蔡伦改进的造纸术在东汉黄河流域推广普及

summary.zh: 东汉宦官蔡伦于公元105年用树皮、麻头、破布、渔网等原料制成植物纤维纸，称“蔡侯纸”。至公元205年左右，这种造纸技术逐渐从洛阳传播到冀州、青州等文化发达地区，取代了昂贵的竹简和缣帛，极大降低了知识传播成本，促进了文化和教育的发展。

statement.zh: 东汉宦官蔡伦于公元105年用树皮、麻头、破布、渔网等原料制成植物纤维纸，称“蔡侯纸”。至公元205年左右，这种造纸技术逐渐从洛阳传播到冀州、青州等文化发达地区，取代了昂贵的竹简和缣帛，极大降低了知识传播成本，促进了文化和教育的发展。
statement.en:
Eastern Han eunuch Cai Lun made plant-fiber paper from tree bark, hemp, rags, and fishing nets in 105 AD, known as 'Marquis Cai's paper.' By around 205, this papermaking technique gradually spread from Luoyang to culturally advanced regions like Jizhou and Qingzhou, replacing expensive bamboo slips and silk, greatly reducing the cost of knowledge dissemination and promoting culture and education.

For Asia in 205 CE, “Cai Lun's improved papermaking technology spreads in the Yellow River region of Eastern Han” is a traceable node of Technology change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 曹操颁布《收田租令》，实行定额田租制

summary.zh: 曹操在平定河北后，针对东汉末年税制混乱的局面，颁布《收田租令》，规定每亩征收粟四升，每户征收绢二匹、绵二斤，严禁豪强额外摊派。这一政策减轻了自耕农负担，增加了政府财政收入，为曹魏政权的经济基础奠定关键制度。

statement.zh: 曹操在平定河北后，针对东汉末年税制混乱的局面，颁布《收田租令》，规定每亩征收粟四升，每户征收绢二匹、绵二斤，严禁豪强额外摊派。
statement.en: After pacifying Hebei, Cao Cao addressed the chaotic tax system of the late Eastern Han by issuing the 'Edict on Grain Collection,' which stipulated that each mu of land should pay four sheng of millet, and each household pay two bolts of silk and two jin of floss silk, forbidding powerful families from imposing extra levies.

title.zh: 罗马皇帝塞维鲁在帕拉丁山扩建皇宫，建造塞维鲁凯旋门

summary.zh: 塞普提米乌斯·塞维鲁为纪念对帕提亚的胜利，在罗马广场西北端建造了三拱的塞维鲁凯旋门，门上的浮雕描绘了罗马军团攻陷帕提亚首都泰西封的场景。同时他扩建了帕拉丁山上的皇家居所，将多座共和时期的贵族住宅连接起来，形成了早期的宫殿建筑群，罗马帝国皇帝的住所从此被称为“Palatium”。

statement.en:
To commemorate his victory over Parthia, Septimius Severus built the triple‑triumphal Arch of Severus at the northwestern end of the Roman Forum, with reliefs depicting the capture of the Parthian capital Ctesiphon. He also expanded the imperial residence on the Palatine Hill, connecting several Republican‑era aristocratic houses into an early palace complex. Thereafter, the Roman emperor's residence was known as the 'Palatium'.

For Europe in 206 CE, “Roman emperor Severus expands palace on Palatine Hill, builds Arch of Severus” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 曹操攻灭并州刺史高干，完全控制黄河以北

summary.zh: 袁绍的外甥高干据守并州（今山西），曹操在消灭袁谭后率军北上进攻壶关（今山西长治）。高干向匈奴求救未果，突围投奔荆州刘表，途中被杀。曹操彻底平定并州，至此完全统一中国北方，南方的刘表、孙权、刘备等势力已无力单独对抗曹操。

statement.zh: 袁绍的外甥高干据守并州（今山西），曹操在消灭袁谭后率军北上进攻壶关（今山西长治）。高干向匈奴求救未果，突围投奔荆州刘表，途中被杀。曹操彻底平定并州，至此完全统一中国北方，南方的刘表、孙权、刘备等势力已无力单独对抗曹操。
statement.en:
Gao Gan, Yuan Shao's nephew, held Bingzhou (modern Shanxi). After destroying Yuan Tan, Cao Cao marched north to attack Huguan (modern Changzhi, Shanxi). Gao Gan sought help from the Xiongnu but failed; he fled to Jingzhou to take refuge with Liu Biao, but was killed on the way. Cao Cao completely pacified Bingzhou, thereby unifying all of northern China. The southern warlords Liu Biao, Sun Quan, and Liu Bei could no longer oppose Cao Cao alone.

For Asia in 206 CE, “Cao Cao attacks and destroys Gao Gan, governor of Bingzhou, securing full control north of the Yellow River” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 诸葛亮在隆中对中提出三分天下战略，出山辅佐刘备

summary.zh: 刘备三顾茅庐拜访隐居隆中的诸葛亮。诸葛亮在草庐中提出了著名的《隆中对》：占据荆州、益州，与东吴结盟，待天下有变则从荆州和汉中两路北伐中原。这一战略规划为刘备集团提供了明确的政治路线。刘备说服诸葛亮出山，任命他为军师中郎将，诸葛亮从此成为刘备最重要的谋士。

title.zh: 曹操白狼山一战大破乌桓骑兵，统一中国北方

summary.zh: 曹操采用谋士郭嘉的建议，轻兵急进，出卢龙塞（今河北迁西），在白狼山（今辽宁喀左）遭遇乌桓主力骑兵。曹操以张辽为先锋，趁敌阵未稳发起猛攻，乌桓首领蹋顿被斩，乌桓二十余万人投降。袁尚、袁熙逃往辽东投奔公孙康，公孙康畏惧曹操，将二袁首级献上。至此中国北方全部统一。

title.zh: 罗马帝国非洲行省成为帝国粮仓，向罗马输送大量谷物

summary.zh: 罗马皇帝塞维鲁加强了对非洲行省的统治，今日突尼斯和阿尔及利亚地区的大庄园利用罗马水利技术扩大橄榄和谷物种植。迦太基、乌提卡等港口每年向罗马输送约800万摩迪（约6000吨）的小麦，以及大量橄榄油。这些农产品税收是帝国财政的重要支柱。

statement.zh: 罗马皇帝塞维鲁加强了对非洲行省的统治，今日突尼斯和阿尔及利亚地区的大庄园利用罗马水利技术扩大橄榄和谷物种植。迦太基、乌提卡等港口每年向罗马输送约800万摩迪（约6000吨）的小麦，以及大量橄榄油。这些农产品税收是帝国财政的重要支柱。
statement.en:
Emperor Severus strengthened his rule over Africa Province. Large estates in modern Tunisia and Algeria expanded olive and grain cultivation using Roman hydraulic technology. Ports such as Carthage and Utica each year shipped about 8 million modii (about 6,000 tons) of wheat to Rome, along with large quantities of olive oil. Tax revenues from these agricultural products were a vital part of the imperial budget.

For Africa in 207 CE, “Roman Africa Province becomes the empire's breadbasket, shipping huge amounts of grain to Rome” is a traceable node of Economy change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 孙权将其妹嫁给刘备以巩固孙刘联盟

title.zh: 曹操颁布《求贤令》，强调“唯才是举”

summary.zh: 曹操在邺城发布《求贤令》，公开提出“唯才是举”的用人原则，明确说“若必廉士而后可用，则齐桓其何以霸世？”宣称即使“负污辱之名，见笑之行，或不仁不孝而有治国用兵之术”的人才也应当举荐。这一政策打破了东汉以道德名教为标准的察举制，使得大量出身低微但有实际才能的人进入曹魏政权。

statement.zh: 曹操在邺城发布《求贤令》，公开提出“唯才是举”的用人原则，明确说“若必廉士而后可用，则齐桓其何以霸世？
statement.en: At Yecheng, Cao Cao issued the 'Call for Talent,' openly proposing a principle of 'employment based solely on ability.' He declared: 'If we required that only incorruptible men be used, then how could Duke Huan of Qi have become hegemon?' He proclaimed that even men 'with stains on their reputation, laughable conduct, or even lacking benevolence and filial piety but having the skills to govern the state and command armies' should be recommended.

title.zh: 罗马皇帝卡拉卡拉为巩固权力杀死其弟盖塔

summary.zh: 公元211年塞维鲁去世后，卡拉卡拉和盖塔共同继位。卡拉卡拉企图独裁，在母亲朱莉娅·多米娜面前杀死了时年22岁的盖塔及其支持者。随后卡拉卡拉下令销毁一切带有盖塔名字和形象的铭文、钱币和雕塑（史称“除忆诅咒”），并以此为契机清洗了约两万名盖塔的支持者，包括元老和近卫军军官。

title.zh: 卡拉卡拉把罗马公民权授予帝国自由民

summary.zh: 212年，卡拉卡拉颁布《安东尼努斯敕令》，把罗马公民权授予帝国所有自由居民。公民权此前已逐步扩展，敕令使其普遍化；古代史料指责卡拉卡拉只是为了增税，现代研究只把增税列为一种可能。敕令改变了帝国身份与法律的边界，但没有立刻让所有人平等。

statement.zh: 212年，卡拉卡拉颁布《安东尼努斯敕令》，把罗马公民权授予帝国所有自由居民。
statement.en: In 212 CE Caracalla issued the Constitutio Antoniniana, granting Roman citizenship to all free inhabitants of the empire.

sources.locator: Britannica, Caracalla, opening paragraph
sources.excerpt: His principal achievements were his colossal baths in Rome and his edict of 212, giving Roman citizenship to all free inhabitants of the empire.

sources.locator: Britannica, Caracalla, 'What was the Edict of Caracalla?'
sources.excerpt: The Edict of Caracalla, issued in 212 CE by Roman Emperor Caracalla, granted Roman citizenship to all free inhabitants of the Roman Empire.

zh: 212年，卡拉卡拉颁布《安东尼努斯敕令》，把罗马公民权授予帝国所有自由居民。
en: In 212 CE Caracalla issued the Constitutio Antoniniana, granting Roman citizenship to all free inhabitants of the empire.

note.zh: 写“所有自由居民”，不写“所有自由男性/女性”这种条目未细分的表述。
note.en: Uses 'all free inhabitants', not a finer male/female division the entry does not make.

statement.zh: 公民权此前已经逐步扩展，敕令使它变得普遍；作为身份区分的意义下降。
statement.en: Citizenship had already been extended gradually; the edict made it universal and reduced its value as a status distinction.

sources.locator: Britannica, Caracalla, 'What was the Edict of Caracalla?'
sources.excerpt: Caracalla's reign, marked by violence and megalomania, aimed to increase revenue by expanding tax obligations to a broader population. While citizenship had been gradually extended, the Edict made it universal, diminishing its significance as a distinction and altering commemorative practices.

zh: 公民权此前已经逐步扩展，敕令使它变得普遍；作为身份区分的意义下降。
en: Citizenship had already been extended gradually; the edict made it universal and reduced its value as a status distinction.

note.zh: 写“意义下降”，不写“政治价值立刻归零”。
note.en: Says the distinction lost value, not that it collapsed overnight.

statement.zh: 古代史料把敕令说成只为增加税收的装置；现代研究只把扩大税基列为一种可能动机，不能证明它是唯一原因。
statement.en: Ancient sources present the edict as a device designed only to raise taxes; modern scholarship treats a broader tax base as one possible motive, not a proven sole cause.

sources.locator: Britannica, Caracalla, 'What was the Edict of Caracalla?'
sources.excerpt: Caracalla's reign, marked by violence and megalomania, aimed to increase revenue by expanding tax obligations to a broader population. While citizenship had been gradually extended, the Edict made it universal, diminishing its significance as a distinction and altering commemorative practices.

sources.locator: Britannica, Caracalla, paragraph 4
sources.excerpt: …ancient sources… slander Caracalla’s most famous measure, the so-called Constitutio Antoniniana de Civitate, as a device designed solely to collect more taxes.

zh: 古代史料把敕令说成只为增加税收的装置；现代研究只把扩大税基列为一种可能动机，不能证明它是唯一原因。
en: Ancient sources present the edict as a device designed only to raise taxes; modern scholarship treats a broader tax base as one possible motive, not a proven sole cause.

note.zh: 把古代指责与现代研究并列，不把增税当成唯一原因。
note.en: Ancient accusation and modern caution are kept side by side.

statement.zh: 敕令之后，行省自由民在法律上成为罗马公民。
statement.en: After the edict, free provincial inhabitants were Roman citizens in law.

sources.locator: Britannica, Caracalla, 'What was the Edict of Caracalla?'
sources.excerpt: The Edict of Caracalla, issued in 212 CE by Roman Emperor Caracalla, granted Roman citizenship to all free inhabitants of the Roman Empire.

zh: 敕令之后，行省自由民在法律上成为罗马公民。
en: After the edict, free provincial inhabitants were Roman citizens in law.

note.zh: 只写法律身份，不写社会现实立刻平等。
note.en: Legal status only; no claim of immediate social equality.

statement.zh: 帝国并未因此变成所有人的平等共同体；公民权仍是帝国统治的工具，只是边界变宽了。
statement.en: The empire did not thereby become a community of equals; citizenship remained an instrument of imperial rule, only with wider boundaries.

note.zh: 作者判断：公民权普遍化不等于政治平等。

title.zh: 曹操首席谋士荀彧因反对曹操进爵国公而自杀

summary.zh: 曹操谋划进爵魏公，增加封地至十郡，设置丞相以下的百官。荀彧认为“本兴义兵以匡朝宁国，不宜如此”，公开表示反对。曹操怀恨在心，借征讨孙权之机，命荀彧随军至谯县（今安徽亳州），后又留在寿春。荀彧在寿春生病，听说曹操赠送空食盒暗示逼其自裁，于是饮药自杀，时年50岁。荀彧之死标志曹操彻底脱离汉朝框架。

statement.zh: 曹操谋划进爵魏公，增加封地至十郡，设置丞相以下的百官。荀彧认为“本兴义兵以匡朝宁国，不宜如此”，公开表示反对。曹操怀恨在心，借征讨孙权之机，命荀彧随军至谯县（今安徽亳州），后又留在寿春。荀彧在寿春生病，听说曹操赠送空食盒暗示逼其自裁，于是饮药自杀，时年50岁。荀彧之死标志曹操彻底脱离汉朝框架。
statement.en:
Cao Cao planned to be made Duke of Wei, adding ten commanderies to his fief and establishing a bureaucracy equivalent to that of the imperial court. Xun Yu argued, 'We originally raised a righteous army to restore the court and bring peace to the state; this should not be done.' He openly expressed opposition. Cao Cao bore a grudge and, using a campaign against Sun Quan as a pretext, ordered Xun Yu to accompany the army to Qiao County (modern Bozhou, Anhui) and then left him at Shouchun. Falling ill at Shouchun, Xun Yu received an empty food box from Cao Cao, a hint to commit suicide, and took poison. He was 50. Xun Yu's death marked Cao Cao's complete break from the Han framework.

For Asia in 212 CE, “Cao Cao's chief strategist Xun Yu commits suicide for opposing Cao Cao's elevation to duke” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 孙权迁都秣陵并修筑石头城，改名建业

summary.zh: 孙权听从张纮、诸葛亮等人的建议，将统治中心从京口（今镇江）西迁至秣陵（今南京），在清凉山上利用自然山势修筑石头城。该城凭江而守，地势险要，主要驻屯水军和储存军械。此后孙权将秣陵改名为建业，意为“建立帝王大业”。建业成为日后东吴的政治、经济中心，也是南京作为六朝古都的开端。

statement.zh: 孙权听从张纮、诸葛亮等人的建议，将统治中心从京口（今镇江）西迁至秣陵（今南京），在清凉山上利用自然山势修筑石头城。
statement.en: Following the advice of Zhang Hong, Zhuge Liang, and others, Sun Quan moved his administrative center from Jingkou (modern Zhenjiang) west to Moling (modern Nanjing).

title.zh: 汉献帝册封曹操为魏公，建立魏国，划给十郡封地

summary.zh: 汉献帝迫于曹操压力，下诏册封曹操为魏公，加九锡，设置魏国百官，以冀州十郡为封地，都城设于邺城。这是东汉异姓封公的第一例（此前只有王莽封安汉公）。魏公国的建立意味着曹操正式脱离汉朝官僚体系，拥有独立的宗庙、尚书台和百官，向取代汉朝迈出了决定性的一步。

title.zh: 汉献帝皇后伏氏因谋诛曹操失败，被废黜并处死

summary.zh: 伏皇后早先曾写信给其父伏完，密谋诛杀曹操，但伏完不敢行动。214年事情泄露，曹操逼迫汉献帝废黜伏皇后，并派御史大夫郗虑持节策收皇后玺绶。伏皇后被幽禁而死，其所生的两位皇子也被毒杀。曹操随即将自己的女儿曹节立为皇后，进一步加强了对皇权的控制。

statement.zh: 伏皇后早先曾写信给其父伏完，密谋诛杀曹操，但伏完不敢行动。214年事情泄露，曹操逼迫汉献帝废黜伏皇后，并派御史大夫郗虑持节策收皇后玺绶。伏皇后被幽禁而死，其所生的两位皇子也被毒杀。曹操随即将自己的女儿曹节立为皇后，进一步加强了对皇权的控制。
statement.en:
Empress Fu had earlier written to her father Fu Wan, plotting to assassinate Cao Cao, but Fu Wan dared not act. In 214, the plot was exposed. Cao Cao forced Emperor Xian to depose Empress Fu and sent the censor‑in‑chief Xi Lu to take her seal. Empress Fu was imprisoned and died, and her two sons were poisoned. Cao Cao then made his own daughter Cao Jie empress, further tightening his control over the imperial house.

For Asia in 214 CE, “Empress Fu, wife of Emperor Xian of Han, deposed and executed after failed plot against Cao Cao” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 曹操率军进入陇右，收服杨秋，平定凉州

summary.zh: 夏侯渊在凉州讨伐马超余部和氐羌叛乱，曹操亲率大军进入陇右（今甘肃东部）。韩遂被部下杀死献首，夏侯渊在长离（今甘肃东部）大破兴国氐王，又围攻枹罕（今甘肃临夏）斩杀宋建，陇右遂平。曹操留夏侯渊镇守长安，自己返回邺城。凉州的平定使曹魏的西部疆域扩展到黄河上游。

statement.zh: 夏侯渊在凉州讨伐马超余部和氐羌叛乱，曹操亲率大军进入陇右（今甘肃东部）。韩遂被部下杀死献首，夏侯渊在长离（今甘肃东部）大破兴国氐王，又围攻枹罕（今甘肃临夏）斩杀宋建，陇右遂平。曹操留夏侯渊镇守长安，自己返回邺城。凉州的平定使曹魏的西部疆域扩展到黄河上游。
statement.en:
Xiahou Yuan campaigned in Liangzhou against the remnants of Ma Chao and the Di and Qiang rebels. Cao Cao personally led an army into Longyou (eastern Gansu). Han Sui was killed by his subordinates, who presented his head. Xiahou Yuan defeated the Di king of Xingguo at Changli (eastern Gansu) and besieged and beheaded Song Jian at Fuhan (modern Linxia, Gansu), thereby pacifying Longyou. Cao Cao left Xiahou Yuan to guard Chang'an and returned to Yecheng. The pacification of Liangzhou extended Cao Wei's western territory to the upper reaches of the Yellow River.

For Asia in 214 CE, “Cao Cao leads army into Longyou, subdues Yang Qiu, pacifies Liangzhou” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 罗马皇帝卡拉卡拉远征日耳曼，沿莱茵河修筑要塞

summary.zh: 为获取军事荣誉和战利品以巩固统治，卡拉卡拉率军出征日耳曼尼亚。他沿莱茵河一线修复和新建了多个军团要塞，并在美因茨地区与阿勒曼尼人交战。实际上他更多是进行威慑性炫耀武力，并收买日耳曼部落酋长，而非大规模征服。他在日耳曼的行军暴露出军队纪律涣散的问题。

title.zh: 卡拉卡拉东征帕提亚，攻掠美索不达米亚

title.zh: 汉献帝册封曹操为魏王，位在诸侯王之上

summary.zh: 汉献帝被迫册封曹操为魏王，其地位高于所有诸侯王，并享有天子仪仗（如冕十二旒、乘金根车、驾六马、设五时副车）。曹操在邺城建立王都，设宗庙，立曹丕为魏太子。虽然名义上仍称汉臣，但实际上曹操已是事实上的皇帝，东汉名存实亡。

title.zh: 建安大瘟疫席卷中原，建安七子中多人病逝

summary.zh: 公元217年冬到218年春，一场严重瘟疫席卷中国北方，邺城、许都、洛阳等地死亡人数众多。曹丕在《与吴质书》中哀悼说：“昔年疾疫，亲故多离其灾，徐、陈、应、刘，一时俱逝。”建安七子中的徐干、陈琳、应玚、刘桢四人同一年染疫身亡，此外王粲也在前一年病逝。这场瘟疫对士人阶层打击巨大，也影响了曹魏文化建设。

title.zh: 罗马皇帝亚历山大·塞维鲁被士兵杀害，三世纪危机加剧

summary.zh: 罗马皇帝亚历山大·塞维鲁在美因茨与日耳曼人交战，由于他试图用金钱而非武力解决问题，引发士兵不满。禁卫军哗变，冲入皇帝的帐篷，将亚历山大及其母亲杀害，时年27岁。随后士兵拥立马克西米努斯·色雷克斯（Maximinus Thrax）为帝，这是一位来自色雷斯的蛮族出身军官。该事件开启了罗马“三世纪危机”中军事无政府状态的混乱时期。

statement.zh: 罗马皇帝亚历山大·塞维鲁在美因茨与日耳曼人交战，由于他试图用金钱而非武力解决问题，引发士兵不满。禁卫军哗变，冲入皇帝的帐篷，将亚历山大及其母亲杀害，时年27岁。随后士兵拥立马克西米努斯·色雷克斯（Maximinus Thrax）为帝，这是一位来自色雷斯的蛮族出身军官。该事件开启了罗马“三世纪危机”中军事无政府状态的混乱时期。
statement.en:
Roman emperor Severus Alexander fought the Germans at Mainz. When he tried to solve the problem with money rather than force, he provoked the soldiers' discontent. The Praetorian Guard mutinied, rushed into the emperor's tent, and killed Alexander (aged 27) and his mother. The soldiers then proclaimed Maximinus Thrax, a low‑born officer from Thrace, as emperor. This event ushered in the chaotic military anarchy phase of the Roman 'Crisis of the Third Century'.

For Europe in 217 CE, “Roman emperor Severus Alexander killed by soldiers, escalating the Crisis of the Third Century” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

summary.zh: 卡拉卡拉东征帕提亚期间，在卡莱（今土耳其哈兰）附近神庙祭拜时，被一名叫茹利乌斯·马尔提亚利斯的禁卫军军官刺杀。刺客可能是受帕提亚人或禁卫军长官马克里努斯指使。卡拉卡拉时年29岁，他的死结束了塞维鲁王朝的直接统治。

statement.zh: 卡拉卡拉东征帕提亚期间，在卡莱（今土耳其哈兰）附近神庙祭拜时，被一名叫茹利乌斯·马尔提亚利斯的禁卫军军官刺杀。刺客可能是受帕提亚人或禁卫军长官马克里努斯指使。卡拉卡拉时年29岁，他的死结束了塞维鲁王朝的直接统治。
statement.en:
During his eastern campaign against Parthia, Caracalla was assassinated near Carrhae (modern Harran, Turkey) while visiting a temple. The assassin was a Praetorian officer named Julius Martialis. The assassin may have been instigated by the Parthians or the Praetorian prefect Macrinus. Caracalla was 29. His death ended the direct rule of the Severan dynasty.

For Europe in 217 CE, “Roman emperor Caracalla assassinated near Carrhae” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 叙利亚少年埃拉伽巴路斯被拥立为帝，与马克里努斯争位

summary.zh: 前皇帝卡拉卡拉的母亲朱莉娅·梅萨在叙利亚煽动叛乱，拥立其14岁的外孙埃拉伽巴路斯为帝，宣称他是卡拉卡拉的私生子。马克里努斯派军镇压，双方在安条克附近会战。马克里努斯见战况不利逃跑，被追兵杀死。元老院迫于压力承认埃拉伽巴路斯为帝。这位少年皇帝极度迷信东方的太阳神崇拜，强迫罗马人尊崇叙利亚神祇。

title.zh: 罗马皇帝埃拉伽巴路斯强迫元老院接受叙利亚太阳神崇拜，引发文化冲突

summary.zh: 埃拉伽巴路斯将叙利亚埃梅萨的太阳神石（一块黑色陨石）带到罗马，在帕拉丁山上建造神庙，要求元老院和骑士举行祭拜仪式。他还迎娶维斯塔贞女，并任命叙利亚神职人员担任罗马高官。保守的罗马人对此极为反感，士兵和元老们对他的蔑视日益增长。这一文化冲突加速了埃拉伽巴路斯的倒台。

title.zh: 曹丕采纳陈群建议，正式设立九品中正制

summary.zh: 魏文帝曹丕为争取士族支持，采纳尚书陈群之议，建立九品中正制。由中央选派朝官兼任州郡的中正官，负责按照家世、品德、才能三方面评定本地士人，分为九等，作为授官依据。这一制度在初期为曹魏选拔了大量人才，但后来中正逐渐由世家大族把持，门第成为唯一标准，导致“上品无寒门，下品无势族”的局面。

statement.zh: 魏文帝曹丕为争取士族支持，采纳尚书陈群之议，建立九品中正制。由中央选派朝官兼任州郡的中正官，负责按照家世、品德、才能三方面评定本地士人，分为九等，作为授官依据。这一制度在初期为曹魏选拔了大量人才，但后来中正逐渐由世家大族把持，门第成为唯一标准，导致“上品无寒门，下品无势族”的局面。
statement.en:
To win the support of the gentry, Emperor Wen of Wei (Cao Pi) accepted the proposal of the minister Chen Qun and established the nine‑rank system (jiupin zhongzheng). Central government officials served as zhongzheng in the provinces and commanderies, responsible for evaluating local men according to three criteria: pedigree, virtue, and talent, dividing them into nine grades as the basis for appointment. In its early stages, the system selected many talented men for Cao Wei, but later the zhongzheng were gradually monopolized by great clans, and pedigree became the only criterion, leading to the situation where 'there were no humble families in the high ranks and no powerful families in the low ranks.'

For Asia in 220 CE, “Cao Pi adopts Chen Qun's proposal and formally institutes the nine‑rank system for official recruitment” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

In its early stages, the system selected many talented men for Cao Wei, but later the zhongzheng were gradually monopolized by great clans, and pedigree became the only criterion, leading to the situation where 'there were no humble families in the high ranks and no powerful families in the low ranks.'

title.zh: 中美洲特奥蒂瓦坎城邦进入繁荣期，太阳金字塔扩建

summary.zh: 特奥蒂瓦坎（Teotihuacan）位于今墨西哥城东北50公里，公元1-7世纪是其鼎盛时期。约在公元220年前后，这座城市人口超过10万，面积达20平方公里，是中美洲最大的城市。太阳金字塔完成第三次扩建，高达65米；月亮金字塔和羽蛇神庙也相继建成。特奥蒂瓦坎通过黑曜石贸易控制了整个中美洲，其艺术和建筑风格影响了后来的玛雅和阿兹特克文明。

statement.zh: 特奥蒂瓦坎（Teotihuacan）位于今墨西哥城东北50公里，公元1-7世纪是其鼎盛时期。
statement.en: Teotihuacan, located 50 km northeast of modern Mexico City, was at its height from the 1st to 7th centuries AD.

zh: 特奥蒂瓦坎（Teotihuacan）位于今墨西哥城东北50公里，公元1-7世纪是其鼎盛时期。
en: Teotihuacan, located 50 km northeast of modern Mexico City, was at its height from the 1st to 7th centuries AD.

title.zh: 哥特人首次大规模越过多瑙河入侵罗马帝国

summary.zh: 哥特人（Goths）一支斯基泰人后裔，在德涅斯特河一带形成部落联盟。公元220年左右，哥特人越过多瑙河，劫掠罗马帝国的达契亚行省和默西亚行省。罗马军队兵力不足，只能击退而无法根除入侵。此后哥特人连年骚扰巴尔干半岛，成为罗马帝国北部边境最大的威胁之一。

title.zh: 刘备在成都即皇帝位，国号汉，史称蜀汉

summary.zh: 章武元年（221年）四月，刘备在诸葛亮等群臣劝进下，于成都武担山之南设坛即皇帝位，国号仍称"汉"，史称蜀汉。此前他听闻曹丕篡汉、汉献帝已遇害的传言（实则献帝被废为山阳公，尚在人世），遂为之发丧、追谥"孝愍皇帝"，以承续汉室正统自任。即位后改元章武，以诸葛亮为丞相，许靖为司徒，张飞为车骑将军，马超为骠骑将军。魏、蜀、吴三分天下之势由此确立。

statement.zh: 章武元年（221年）四月，刘备在诸葛亮等群臣劝进下，于成都武担山之南设坛即皇帝位，国号仍称"汉"，史称蜀汉。
statement.en: In the fourth month of 221, urged on by Zhuge Liang and his other ministers, Liu Bei raised an altar south of Mount Wudan at Chengdu and took the imperial title, keeping "Han" as the name of the dynasty.

sources.locator: Wikipedia, "Shu Han", full article, evidence sentence 12
sources.excerpt: Liu Bei contested Cao Pi's claim to the throne, and proclaimed himself "Emperor of Han" in 221.

title.zh: 刘备为报关羽之仇，兴兵七万伐吴

summary.zh: 刘备在成都称帝后，不顾赵云、诸葛亮等人的劝阻，以“为关羽报仇”为名，御驾亲征东吴。刘备督率七万蜀汉精锐，包括张飞（张飞在出征前被部将杀害）、吴班、冯习、黄权等将领，沿长江东下，攻占巫县、秭归。孙权派诸葛瑾求和，刘备拒绝。孙权被迫向曹丕称藩，并任命陆逊为大都督，率五万军队迎战。

statement.zh: 刘备在成都称帝后，不顾赵云、诸葛亮等人的劝阻，以“为关羽报仇”为名，御驾亲征东吴。
statement.en: After proclaiming himself emperor in Chengdu, Liu Bei, ignoring the remonstrances of Zhao Yun, Zhuge Liang, and others, personally led a campaign against Eastern Wu 'to avenge Guan Yu.' Liu Bei commanded 70,000 elite Shu troops, including generals Zhang Fei (who was murdered by his own subordinates just before the campaign set out), Wu Ban, Feng Xi, and Huang Quan, and advanced east along the Yangtze, capturing Wu County and Zigui.

sources.locator: Wikipedia, "Liu Bei", full article, evidence sentence 347
sources.excerpt: He said to Sun Yu: "If you take Yi then I shall let my hair down, go into the mountains and become a hermit so I would not lose the trust of the empire."Also he ordered Guan Yu to encamp at Jiangling, Zhang Fei at Zigui, Zhuge Liang in Nan commandery and Liu Bei himself led his men at Zhanling.

title.zh: 魏文帝曹丕册封孙权为吴王，加九锡，赐荆州牧

summary.zh: 刘备伐吴，孙权为避免两线作战，向曹丕称臣，接受魏国册封的吴王称号。曹丕赐给孙权九锡，并授予荆州牧之职。孙权派陆逊、诸葛瑾等与魏国保持良好关系，同时秘密积蓄力量。曹丕虽想乘机灭吴，但经刘晔劝谏后暂未行动。

title.zh: 罗马少年皇帝亚历山大·塞维鲁即位，元老院恢复一定权威

summary.zh: 亚历山大·塞维鲁被元老院承认为罗马皇帝，他只有13岁，实际权力由祖母朱莉娅·梅萨和母亲朱莉娅·马麦亚掌握。亚历山大接受过良好的教育，重视法律和元老院，提拔了一批有能力的法学家和行政官员。在他统治前期，罗马局势相对稳定，但军队权力过大问题依然存在。

statement.zh: 亚历山大·塞维鲁被元老院承认为罗马皇帝，他只有13岁，实际权力由祖母朱莉娅·梅萨和母亲朱莉娅·马麦亚掌握。亚历山大接受过良好的教育，重视法律和元老院，提拔了一批有能力的法学家和行政官员。在他统治前期，罗马局势相对稳定，但军队权力过大问题依然存在。
statement.en:
Severus Alexander was recognized as Roman emperor by the Senate. He was only 13, and real power was held by his grandmother Julia Maesa and his mother Julia Mamaea. Alexander had received a good education, respected law and the Senate, and promoted a number of talented jurists and administrators. In the early part of his reign, the Roman situation was relatively stable, but the problem of excessive military power remained.

For Europe in 222 CE, “Roman teenage emperor Severus Alexander ascends; Senate regains some authority” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

en: Severus Alexander was recognized as Roman emperor by the Senate. He was only 13, and real power was held by his grandmother Julia Maesa and his mother Julia Mamaea. Alexander had received a good education, respected law and the Senate, and promoted a number of talented jurists and administrators. In the early part of his reign, the Roman situation was relatively stable, but the problem of excessive military power remained.
Severus Alexander was recognized as Roman emperor by the Senate.

title.zh: 刘备夷陵之战惨败，逃往白帝城，次年病逝

summary.zh: 刘备伐吴大军连营七百里，自巫峡至夷陵（今湖北宜昌东南）。陆逊采取坚守不战的策略，在蜀军锐气耗尽、天气暑热时，下令火攻。吴军顺风纵火，烧毁蜀军连营四十余座。蜀军大溃，死伤数万，舟船器械损失殆尽。刘备逃往白帝城（今重庆奉节），改其名为永安。次年四月，刘备病笃，召诸葛亮托孤，言“若嗣子可辅，辅之；如其不才，君可自取”。刘备逝世，刘禅继位。

summary.zh: 曹丕不满孙权不遣质子，下令三路伐吴：曹仁攻濡须，曹休、曹真、张辽出洞口，夏侯尚、徐晃攻江陵。吴军依托长江天险和坚固城防顽强抵抗。朱桓在濡须大破曹仁，朱然在江陵坚守六个月。曹魏水军不占优势，疫病流行，曹丕下令撤军。此战魏军损兵折将，未能达到灭吴目的。

statement.en:
Angry that Sun Quan had not sent a hostage, Cao Pi ordered a three‑pronged attack on Wu: Cao Ren attacked Ru'xu; Cao Xiu, Cao Zhen, and Zhang Liao attacked the river mouth; and Xiahou Shang and Xu Huang attacked Jiangling. The Wu army relied on the natural defenses of the Yangtze and stout walls to resist tenaciously. Zhu Huan badly defeated Cao Ren at Ruxu, and Zhu Ran held Jiangling for six months. The Wei navy had no advantage, and an epidemic spread. Cao Pi ordered a withdrawal. The Wei forces suffered heavy losses and did not achieve their goal of destroying Wu.

For Asia in 223 CE, “Emperor Wen of Wei (Cao Pi) launches a three‑pronged invasion of Wu, but fails to achieve his aim” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: 阿尔达希尔一世（Ardashir I）是波斯地区法尔斯省的地方贵族，他起兵反抗帕提亚安息帝国（Arsacid Empire）的统治。经过多年征战，于224年在霍尔木兹平原大败安息国王阿尔塔巴努斯四世，杀死国王，攻陷首都泰西封，建立萨珊王朝。阿尔达希尔宣称自己是阿契美尼德王朝的后裔，恢复波斯正统，琐罗亚斯德教成为国教。这一事件标志着近500年的帕提亚统治结束，波斯再次统一。
statement.en:
Ardashir I was a local noble of Pars province in Persia. He rose in rebellion against the ruling Parthian Arsacid Empire. After years of fighting, in 224 he defeated the Parthian king Artabanus IV on the plain of Hormuz, killed him, captured the capital Ctesiphon, and founded the Sasanian dynasty. Ardashir claimed to be a descendant of the Achaemenid dynasty, restored Persian legitimacy, and made Zoroastrianism the state religion. This event ended nearly 500 years of Parthian rule and reunited Persia.

For Asia in 224 CE, “Ardashir I of Sasanian Persia overthrows the Parthian Empire and founds the Sasanian dynasty” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 曹丕再次亲征东吴，至广陵无功而返

summary.zh: 曹丕不甘前次伐吴失败，这次率水军自谯县入涡水，经淮河至广陵（今江苏扬州）。东吴沿江严密布防，江中遍插木桩，铁索横江。曹丕遥望长江波涛汹涌，叹道：“彼有人焉，未可图也。”此时正逢河水结冰，曹魏战船无法行动，曹丕只得下令班师。广陵之役虎头蛇尾，曹丕未能与吴军交战便退回。

title.zh: 魏文帝曹丕病逝于洛阳，太子曹叡即位

summary.zh: 曹丕在洛阳嘉福殿病逝，享年40岁。他著有《典论》，是中国文学批评史上第一部文学理论专著。他倡导文风改革，是建安文学的重要成员。曹丕去世后，谥号文皇帝，葬首阳陵。太子曹叡（魏明帝）即位，改元太和。

statement.zh: 曹丕在洛阳嘉福殿病逝，享年40岁。他著有《典论》，是中国文学批评史上第一部文学理论专著。他倡导文风改革，是建安文学的重要成员。曹丕去世后，谥号文皇帝，葬首阳陵。太子曹叡（魏明帝）即位，改元太和。
statement.en:
Cao Pi died at the Jiafu Palace in Luoyang at the age of 40. He was the author of the 'Canon of Essays', the first work of literary theory in Chinese literary history. He advocated stylistic reform and was an important member of the Jian'an literary circle. After his death, he received the posthumous title Emperor Wen and was buried at the Shouyang Mausoleum. Crown Prince Cao Rui (Emperor Ming of Wei) ascended the throne, changing the era name to Taihe.

For Asia in 226 CE, “Emperor Wen of Wei (Cao Pi) dies in Luoyang; Crown Prince Cao Rui succeeds” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.en:
Meng Da was a former Shu Han general who had surrendered to Wei, stationed at Xincheng (modern Fang County, Hubei). On the eve of Zhuge Liang's northern expedition, Zhuge Liang wrote to seduce Meng Da into defecting. Meng Da fell out with Wei Xing governor Shen Yi, and planned a rebellion. Sima Yi, on receiving the emergency report, without waiting for an imperial edict, marched day and night, covering 1,200 li in eight days, and surrounded Xincheng before Meng Da could react. After sixteen days the city fell and Meng Da was executed. Sima Yi's rapid action foiled Zhuge Liang's plan to attack from both north and south.

title.zh: 诸葛亮第三次北伐，攻取武都、阴平二郡

summary.zh: 诸葛亮派遣陈式进攻魏国的武都（今甘肃陇南）、阴平（今甘肃文县）二郡。魏雍州刺史郭淮引兵救援，诸葛亮亲自率军至建威（今甘肃西和）阻击，郭淮退走，蜀军顺利占领两郡。这是诸葛亮北伐中唯一一次完全实现战略目标的战役，这两郡的获得为蜀汉增加了人口和战略纵深。

statement.zh: 诸葛亮派遣陈式进攻魏国的武都（今甘肃陇南）、阴平（今甘肃文县）二郡。魏雍州刺史郭淮引兵救援，诸葛亮亲自率军至建威（今甘肃西和）阻击，郭淮退走，蜀军顺利占领两郡。这是诸葛亮北伐中唯一一次完全实现战略目标的战役，这两郡的获得为蜀汉增加了人口和战略纵深。
statement.en:
Zhuge Liang sent Chen Shi to attack the Wei commanderies of Wudu (modern Longnan, Gansu) and Yinping (modern Wen County, Gansu). The Wei Inspector of Yongzhou, Guo Huai, led troops to rescue them, but Zhuge Liang personally led his army to Jianwei (modern Xihe, Gansu) to block him. Guo Huai retreated, and the Shu forces smoothly took the two commanderies. This was the only northern expedition in which Zhuge Liang fully achieved his strategic objective; the acquisition of these two commanderies increased Shu Han's population and strategic depth.

For Asia in 229 CE, “Zhuge Liang's third northern expedition: takes Wudu and Yinping commanderies” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 蜀汉与东吴缔结盟约，正式约定共同伐魏

summary.zh: 孙权称帝后，诸葛亮派陈震出使东吴祝贺，并重新修订盟约。盟约规定“汉吴一体，共伐曹魏”，“若魏有内乱，则双方同时进攻”。双方约定灭魏后，豫、青、徐、幽四州归吴，兖、冀、并、凉四州归蜀，司隶地区以函谷关为界。这种纸上分土实际从未实现，但巩固了蜀吴联盟。

statement.en:
After Sun Quan proclaimed himself emperor, Zhuge Liang sent Chen Zhen to Wu to congratulate him and renew the alliance. The treaty stipulated that 'Han and Wu are one body and will together attack Cao Wei', and that 'if Wei suffers internal disorder, the two sides will attack simultaneously.' They agreed that after Wei was destroyed, Yu, Qing, Xu, and You provinces would go to Wu, while Yan, Ji, Bing, and Liang provinces would go to Shu; the Si province (the capital region) would be divided at Hangu Pass. This paper division of territory was never realized, but it strengthened the Shu–Wu alliance.

In 229 CE, “Shu Han and Eastern Wu conclude a formal alliance, agreeing to jointly attack Wei” belongs to the field of Diplomacy in Asia.

title.zh: 罗马法学家编纂《格列高利法典》，系统整理帝国法令

summary.zh: 罗马法学家格列高利（Gregorius）奉旨编纂法典，系统整理了自哈德良皇帝以来的帝国敕令（Constitutions）。《格列高利法典》虽已失传，但开启了罗马官方法典编纂传统，后来影响狄奥多西法典和查士丁尼法典。罗马法学在这一时期仍保持较高水平。

title.zh: 孙权派遣将军卫温、诸葛直率万人船队赴夷洲求仙访俗

summary.zh: 孙权为探寻传说中的夷洲（今台湾）和亶洲（一说日本），派卫温、诸葛直率领甲士万人乘大船出海。船队抵达夷洲，在当地停留一年，与岛上土著居民进行接触，但“士众疾疫死者十之八九”，未能久留。这是中国历史上官方组织的大规模航海行动之一，也是明确记载中国大陆与台湾之间大规模交往的较早记录。

statement.zh: 孙权为探寻传说中的夷洲（今台湾）和亶洲（一说日本），派卫温、诸葛直率领甲士万人乘大船出海。
statement.en: Sun Quan, hoping to find the legendary islands of Yizhou (modern Taiwan) and Danzhou (possibly Japan), sent Wei Wen and Zhuge Zhi with 10,000 armed men in large ships.

sources.locator: Wikipedia, "Sun Quan", full article, evidence sentence 159
sources.excerpt: Sun Quan was ecstatic, and appointed Gongsun Yuan the Prince of Yan and granted him the nine bestowments, and further sent a detachment of 10,000 men by sea north to assist Gongsun Yuan in his campaign against Wei, against the advice of nearly every single one of his high-level officials, particularly Zhang Zhao.

zh: 孙权为探寻传说中的夷洲（今台湾）和亶洲（一说日本），派卫温、诸葛直率领甲士万人乘大船出海。
en: Sun Quan, hoping to find the legendary islands of Yizhou (modern Taiwan) and Danzhou (possibly Japan), sent Wei Wen and Zhuge Zhi with 10,000 armed men in large ships.

title.zh: 曹魏大司马曹真伐蜀，遇大雨栈道断绝，无功而返

summary.zh: 魏明帝为报复诸葛亮北伐，派曹真率大军从子午谷，司马懿从汉水，张郃从褒斜道，三道伐蜀。曹真进入子午谷后遭遇连续三十多天大雨，栈道被冲毁，粮运不继。魏明帝下令撤军。此役曹魏损失惨重，蜀汉乘机收复武都、阴平两郡。

title.zh: 诸葛亮第四次北伐，制造木牛运粮，与司马懿对峙

summary.zh: 诸葛亮再次率军出祁山，利用木牛（一种手推独轮车）运输粮草，解决了山地运输困难。魏国派司马懿接替曹真总督关中诸军。司马懿采取坚壁不战的策略，任凭蜀军挑战，甚至穿妇人衣服羞辱，仍不出战。两军在卤城相持数月，诸葛亮因粮尽退兵。此战司马懿初步确立了对付蜀军“不宜追击”的经验。

statement.zh: 诸葛亮再次率军出祁山，利用木牛（一种手推独轮车）运输粮草，解决了山地运输困难。魏国派司马懿接替曹真总督关中诸军。司马懿采取坚壁不战的策略，任凭蜀军挑战，甚至穿妇人衣服羞辱，仍不出战。两军在卤城相持数月，诸葛亮因粮尽退兵。此战司马懿初步确立了对付蜀军“不宜追击”的经验。
statement.en:
Zhuge Liang again led his army out of Mount Qi, using 'wooden oxen' (a type of wheelbarrow) to transport grain, solving the problem of moving supplies through mountainous terrain. Wei sent Sima Yi to replace Cao Zhen as commander of the Guanzhong forces. Sima Yi adopted a strategy of building strong walls and refusing to fight; no matter how the Shu army challenged him, even when they sent him women's clothes to humiliate him, he would not come out. The two armies faced each other at Lucheng for months. Zhuge Liang again withdrew for lack of food. In this battle, Sima Yi established the principle of 'not pursuing' against the Shu forces.

For Asia in 231 CE, “Zhuge Liang's fourth northern expedition: uses wooden oxen for transport, confronts Sima Yi” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 陈思王曹植在抑郁中去世，年仅41岁

summary.zh: 曹丕、曹叡两朝，曹植备受猜忌，多次迁徙封地，无法参与朝政。他于232年病逝于陈郡（今河南淮阳）。曹植是建安文学的代表人物，《洛神赋》《赠白马王彪》等作品流传千古。他作为曹操之子，其政治才能不得施展，而在文学上达到了很高成就。

title.zh: 蜀军在退兵后发生魏延与杨仪内讧，魏延被杀

summary.zh: 诸葛亮病逝后，遗令杨仪和费祎率军撤退，魏延断后。魏延不愿撤军，抢先烧毁栈道，阻挡大军。杨仪与魏延相互指责叛逆，魏延军士皆散，逃亡汉中时被马岱所杀，并被诛灭三族。杨仪后来也因口出怨言被贬为民。魏延之死导致蜀汉损失一员猛将，政权内部矛盾加剧。

statement.zh: 诸葛亮病逝后，遗令杨仪和费祎率军撤退，魏延断后。魏延不愿撤军，抢先烧毁栈道，阻挡大军。杨仪与魏延相互指责叛逆，魏延军士皆散，逃亡汉中时被马岱所杀，并被诛灭三族。杨仪后来也因口出怨言被贬为民。魏延之死导致蜀汉损失一员猛将，政权内部矛盾加剧。
statement.en:
After Zhuge Liang's death, his final orders were for Yang Yi and Fei Yi to lead the army back, with Wei Yan to cover the rear. Wei Yan refused to withdraw, burned the plank roads to block the army, and accused Yang Yi of treason. Yang Yi and Wei Yan each accused the other of rebellion. Wei Yan's men scattered, and he was killed by Ma Dai while fleeing to Hanzhong; his family was exterminated. Yang Yi later spoke resentfully and was reduced to common status. The death of Wei Yan cost Shu Han a fierce general and intensified internal conflicts.

title.zh: 三世纪危机：军团、税负与戴克里先的重组

summary.zh: 235年初，士兵杀死亚历山大·塞维鲁及其母亲，拥立马克西米努斯；此后的半个世纪充满内战、篡位与边境压力。危机不是单一原因，而是军事君主制、税负、通胀、商业中断与驻军勒索互相加重。284年戴克里先即位，以四帝共治重建行政；到308年又有七人争夺“奥古斯都”头衔。

statement.zh: 235年初，士兵杀死亚历山大·塞维鲁及其母亲，拥立马克西米努斯为帝；他的软弱统治在内战与内乱中崩溃。
statement.en: Early in 235 soldiers killed Severus Alexander and his mother and proclaimed Maximinus emperor; his weak rule collapsed in civil strife and internal disorder.

sources.locator: Britannica, Severus Alexander, opening paragraph
sources.excerpt: Severus Alexander (born 209, Phoenicia [now in Lebanon]—died 235, Gaul) was a Roman emperor from ad 222 to 235, whose weak rule collapsed in the civil strife that engulfed the empire for the next 50 years.

sources.locator: Britannica, Severus Alexander, 'Early in 235'
sources.excerpt: Early in 235 the soldiers murdered Alexander and his mother and proclaimed Gaius Julius Verus Maximinus as emperor.

zh: 235年初，士兵杀死亚历山大·塞维鲁及其母亲，拥立马克西米努斯为帝；他的软弱统治在内战与内乱中崩溃。
en: Early in 235 soldiers killed Severus Alexander and his mother and proclaimed Maximinus emperor; his weak rule collapsed in civil strife and internal disorder.

note.zh: 235年、凶手与马克西米努斯照条目；不写“26位皇帝”。
note.en: 235, the murderers and Maximinus follow the entry; no '26 emperors'.

statement.zh: 三世纪危机的根源不是单一原因；帝国在193年塞普蒂米乌斯·塞维鲁掌权后，已经变成军事君主制，此后的篡位、政治失稳、蛮族入侵、商业中断、重税、通胀与驻军勒索互相加重。
statement.en: The third-century crisis had no single cause; after Septimius Severus came to power in 193 the empire had effectively become a military monarchy, and usurpation, political instability, barbarian invasion, disrupted commerce, heavy taxation, inflation and extortion by troops reinforced one another.

sources.locator: Britannica, Roman Empire, 'Height and decline of imperial Rome', third century
sources.excerpt: The following century was plagued by strife and mismanagement. When the commander of the Danube army, Septimius Severus, was swept to power in 193, he effectively made Rome a military monarchy. The “barbarian invasions” weighed heavily on the empire, as did usurpations and political destabilization. The instability fed on itself and was responsible for heavy expenditure of both life and treasure. Disruptions in commerce, harsh taxation, inflation, and extortion from stationed troops all contributed to perpetual economic hardship for decades.

zh: 三世纪危机的根源不是单一原因；帝国在193年塞普蒂米乌斯·塞维鲁掌权后，已经变成军事君主制，此后的篡位、政治失稳、蛮族入侵、商业中断、重税、通胀与驻军勒索互相加重。
en: The third-century crisis had no single cause; after Septimius Severus came to power in 193 the empire had effectively become a military monarchy, and usurpation, political instability, barbarian invasion, disrupted commerce, heavy taxation, inflation and extortion by troops reinforced one another.

note.zh: 多因并列，不把“蛮族入侵”当唯一原因。

statement.zh: 危机不是五十年的同一种崩溃；不同地区、不同年代承受的压力不同，城市、乡村与边疆的经验并不一致。
statement.en: The crisis was not one uniform collapse over fifty years; different regions and decades faced different pressures, and the experience of cities, countryside and frontier was not the same.

zh: 危机不是五十年的同一种崩溃；不同地区、不同年代承受的压力不同，城市、乡村与边疆的经验并不一致。
en: The crisis was not one uniform collapse over fifty years; different regions and decades faced different pressures, and the experience of cities, countryside and frontier was not the same.

note.zh: 作者判断：拒绝把三世纪危机写成均匀的“全面崩溃”。
note.en: Author judgment: rejects a uniform 'total collapse' narrative.

statement.zh: 284年，戴克里先即位；他的改革重建了行政系统的完整与凝聚，最著名的是把帝国分成四帝共治：他自己、马克西米安、君士坦提乌斯与伽列里乌斯分掌权力。
statement.en: Diocletian came to power in 284; his reforms renewed the integrity and cohesion of the administration, most famously by dividing the empire into a tetrarchy in which he, Maximian, Constantius and Galerius shared power.

sources.locator: Britannica, Roman Empire, 'Height and decline of imperial Rome', Diocletian
sources.excerpt: A period of recovery began with Diocletian (284–305), whose broad reforms renewed the integrity and cohesion of the imperial administration. His most notable adjustment was the reorganization of the empire into a tetrarchy, wherein power was divided among himself, Maximian (who became Augustus, or emperor, in 286), Constantius (who became Caesar, or hereditary prince, in 293), and Galerius (who also became Caesar in 293). The arrangement proved practical in stabilizing the empire for a time against usurpation, and it also promised the rulers legitimacy and regular succession.

zh: 284年，戴克里先即位；他的改革重建了行政系统的完整与凝聚，最著名的是把帝国分成四帝共治：他自己、马克西米安、君士坦提乌斯与伽列里乌斯分掌权力。
en: Diocletian came to power in 284; his reforms renewed the integrity and cohesion of the administration, most famously by dividing the empire into a tetrarchy in which he, Maximian, Constantius and Galerius shared power.

note.zh: 284年、四帝共治与四人名字照条目；不写“一夜恢复”。
note.en: 284, tetrarchy and the four names follow the entry; no 'recovered overnight'.

statement.zh: 四帝共治在一段时间内抑制了篡位，也给统治者提供了合法性继承的承诺；但到308年，已经有七个人争夺“奥古斯都”头衔。
statement.en: The tetrarchy checked usurpation for a time and promised legitimacy and regular succession; but by 308 seven men were competing for the title of Augustus.

sources.locator: Britannica, Roman Empire, 'Height and decline of imperial Rome', Diocletian
sources.excerpt: A period of recovery began with Diocletian (284–305), whose broad reforms renewed the integrity and cohesion of the imperial administration. His most notable adjustment was the reorganization of the empire into a tetrarchy, wherein power was divided among himself, Maximian (who became Augustus, or emperor, in 286), Constantius (who became Caesar, or hereditary prince, in 293), and Galerius (who also became Caesar in 293). The arrangement proved practical in stabilizing the empire for a time against usurpation, and it also promised the rulers legitimacy and regular succession.

sources.locator: Britannica, Roman Empire, 'Height and decline of imperial Rome', tetrarchy
sources.excerpt: The tetrarchy soon led to confusion, however, and by 308 there were seven pretenders to the title of Augustus.

zh: 四帝共治在一段时间内抑制了篡位，也给统治者提供了合法性继承的承诺；但到308年，已经有七个人争夺“奥古斯都”头衔。
en: The tetrarchy checked usurpation for a time and promised legitimacy and regular succession; but by 308 seven men were competing for the title of Augustus.

note.zh: “七人”照条目；不写“四帝共治彻底失败”。
note.en: Seven pretenders follow the entry; no 'the tetrarchy totally failed'.

statement.zh: 三世纪危机没有让帝国立刻灭亡，但它把元老院政治挤到边缘，也让军队成为皇帝合法性的最终仲裁者。
statement.en: The third-century crisis did not destroy the empire at once, but it pushed Senate politics to the margins and made the army the final arbiter of an emperor's legitimacy.

zh: 三世纪危机没有让帝国立刻灭亡，但它把元老院政治挤到边缘，也让军队成为皇帝合法性的最终仲裁者。
en: The third-century crisis did not destroy the empire at once, but it pushed Senate politics to the margins and made the army the final arbiter of an emperor's legitimacy.

note.zh: 作者判断：把“危机”与“灭亡”分开，强调军队仲裁。
note.en: Author judgment: separates crisis from fall and stresses army arbitration.

title.zh: 魏明帝曹叡大兴土木，修建洛阳宫室，造成国力损耗

summary.zh: 魏明帝曹叡在位后期，大肆兴修宫殿，在洛阳修建昭阳殿、太极殿等，雕梁画栋，极尽奢华。他招募众多民夫，耗费大量钱财，甚至听从高堂隆建议“大治殿舍”。大臣杨阜、高堂隆等多次劝谏，明帝不听。这项劳民伤财的工程加剧了社会矛盾。

statement.zh: 魏明帝曹叡在位后期，大肆兴修宫殿，在洛阳修建昭阳殿、太极殿等，雕梁画栋，极尽奢华。他招募众多民夫，耗费大量钱财，甚至听从高堂隆建议“大治殿舍”。大臣杨阜、高堂隆等多次劝谏，明帝不听。这项劳民伤财的工程加剧了社会矛盾。
statement.en:
In his later years, Emperor Ming of Wei embarked on extensive construction of palaces in Luoyang, including the Zhaoyang and Taiji halls, elaborately decorated. He recruited many laborers, spent huge sums, and even followed the advice of Gao Tanglong to 'grandly build palace chambers.' Ministers such as Yang Fu and Gao Tanglong repeatedly remonstrated, but the emperor ignored them. This ruinous expenditure exacerbated social conflicts.

For Asia in 235 CE, “Emperor Ming of Wei (Cao Rui) embarks on lavish construction of Luoyang palaces, depleting state resources” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 罗马皇帝亚历山大·塞维鲁在美因茨被叛军杀害，塞维鲁王朝终结

summary.zh: 亚历山大·塞维鲁在莱茵河前线与日耳曼人作战，因试图用金钱收买蛮族而非武力解决，引起军中不满。一群叛乱士兵冲入皇帝帐篷，将其和母亲一起杀害。随后拥立色雷斯军官马克西米努斯为帝。亚历山大的死标志着塞维鲁王朝的结束，罗马进入“三世纪危机”中最为混乱的“军事无政府状态”（50年内26位皇帝几乎全被军队拥立并杀害）。

title.zh: 罗马皇帝戈迪安三世被迫与萨珊波斯议和，专注对付国内叛乱

title.zh: 司马懿率军平定辽东，斩杀公孙渊

summary.zh: 司马懿率四万大军征讨公孙渊，以声东击西之计，避开关隘主力，直取襄平（今辽宁辽阳）。公孙渊求救于鲜卑和高句丽，均被司马懿隔绝。魏军围城三个月，城中粮尽，公孙渊出逃被俘。司马懿斩杀公孙渊父子，俘虏数万人，辽东、玄菟、乐浪、带方四郡尽归曹魏。

statement.zh: 司马懿率四万大军征讨公孙渊，以声东击西之计，避开关隘主力，直取襄平（今辽宁辽阳）。公孙渊求救于鲜卑和高句丽，均被司马懿隔绝。魏军围城三个月，城中粮尽，公孙渊出逃被俘。司马懿斩杀公孙渊父子，俘虏数万人，辽东、玄菟、乐浪、带方四郡尽归曹魏。
statement.en:
Sima Yi led 40,000 troops against Gongsun Yuan. Using a feint, he bypassed the main enemy positions and marched directly to Xiangping (modern Liaoyang, Liaoning). Gongsun Yuan called for help from the Xianbei and Goguryeo, but Sima Yi blocked them. The Wei army besieged the city for three months, and when food ran out, Gongsun Yuan tried to flee but was captured. Sima Yi executed Gongsun Yuan and his son, and the four commanderies of Liaodong, Xuantu, Lelang, and Daifang came under Cao Wei control.

For Asia in 238 CE, “Sima Yi leads army to pacify Liaodong, killing Gongsun Yuan” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 罗马帝国内乱，多位皇帝更迭，年号纪年混乱

summary.zh: 238年一年内，罗马帝国有六位皇帝先后被拥立（马克西米努斯、戈迪安一世、戈迪安二世、普皮恩努斯、巴尔比努斯、戈迪安三世），全部被杀或自杀。238年被称为“六帝之年”（Year of the Six Emperors）。此后罗马年号系统混乱，各地军阀自行纪年。

title.zh: 何晏、王弼开创玄学，清谈之风开始在士大夫中流行

summary.zh: 曹魏正始年间（240-249），何晏、王弼等士大夫以《老子》、《庄子》、《周易》（“三玄”）为经典，探讨“有无”、“本末”、“体用”等哲学命题。王弼20岁时注《老子》，提出“以无为本”的本体论，开创了玄学贵无派。玄学兴起反映了士人在政治高压下逃避现实、追求精神自由的思潮，深刻影响了六朝思想文化。

statement.en: During the Zhengshi era (240–249) of Cao Wei, scholar‑officials such as He Yan and Wang Bi studied the 'Three Mysteries' (Laozi, Zhuangzi, and the Book of Changes), exploring philosophical concepts such as 'being and non‑being', 'root and branch', and 'substance and function'.

title.zh: 萨珊帝国沙普尔一世即位，继承其父扩张政策

summary.zh: 阿尔达希尔一世去世，其子沙普尔一世（Shapur I）成为萨珊波斯皇帝。他立即着手巩固东部边境，征服贵霜帝国部分地区，随后转向西方，准备进攻罗马帝国。沙普尔一世在以后的二十年间多次大败罗马军，成为罗马最强劲的对手之一。

title.zh: 司马懿为迷惑曹爽，假装年老病重，暗中联络心腹

summary.zh: 司马懿见曹爽掌权后胡作非为，称病不问政事，并故意在曹爽派来探病的人面前表现老态龙钟、语无伦次。曹爽信以为真，放松了对司马懿的警惕。司马懿则暗中联络蒋济、高柔等老臣，准备发动政变。

statement.zh: 司马懿见曹爽掌权后胡作非为，称病不问政事，并故意在曹爽派来探病的人面前表现老态龙钟、语无伦次。曹爽信以为真，放松了对司马懿的警惕。司马懿则暗中联络蒋济、高柔等老臣，准备发动政变。
statement.en:
Seeing that Cao Shuang was abusing his power, Sima Yi claimed to be ill and took no part in politics. When Cao Shuang sent men to check on him, Sima Yi acted senile and incoherent. Cao Shuang believed him and let down his guard. Sima Yi, meanwhile, secretly contacted old ministers such as Jiang Ji and Gao Rou, preparing a coup.

For Asia in 243 CE, “Sima Yi feigns old age and illness to deceive Cao Shuang, secretly contacting his confidants” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 费祎出任蜀汉大将军，继续蒋琬休养生息政策

summary.zh: 蒋琬因病将政务交给费祎。费祎出任大将军，录尚书事。他延续诸葛亮的治国方针，对内发展经济，对外采取守势，减少北伐消耗。他认为蜀汉国力有限，不宜频繁用兵，因此对姜维的北伐主张多有限制。

title.zh: 罗马少年皇帝戈迪安三世在东征途中神秘去世

summary.zh: 戈迪安三世被军队拥立后，年仅13岁。244年，他与萨珊波斯作战时战死或被杀（具体真相不明）。此后阿拉伯人菲利普成为皇帝，他旋即与波斯缔结和约，承认波斯占领亚美尼亚。罗马帝国在东方的威信大打折扣。

statement.zh: 戈迪安三世被军队拥立后，年仅13岁。244年，他与萨珊波斯作战时战死或被杀（具体真相不明）。此后阿拉伯人菲利普成为皇帝，他旋即与波斯缔结和约，承认波斯占领亚美尼亚。罗马帝国在东方的威信大打折扣。
statement.en:
Gordian III, proclaimed emperor at age 13, died fighting the Sasanian Persians (or was killed) in 244. His successor, Philip the Arab, quickly concluded a peace with Persia, recognizing Persian control of Armenia. Roman prestige in the east was greatly diminished.

For Europe in 244 CE, “Teenage Roman emperor Gordian III mysteriously dies during an eastern campaign” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 普罗提诺创立新柏拉图主义

summary.zh: 普罗提诺在罗马讲授太一、流溢与灵魂回归，集柏拉图主义之大成，影响后世基督教与伊斯兰哲学。

statement.zh: 普罗提诺在罗马讲授太一、流溢与灵魂回归，把柏拉图主义的核心问题整理成一套有层次的形而上学体系。太一是万物所出之源，流溢描述存在如何自高而下展开，灵魂回归则给出人向本源上升的路径；三者连成一体，使他的学说既不同于早期柏拉图对话的散论，也为后世基督教与伊斯兰哲学提供了可借用的概念框架。
statement.en: Plotinus taught in Rome on the One, emanation and the soul's return, shaping the central questions of Platonism into a layered metaphysical system.

title.zh: 罗马皇帝阿拉伯人菲利普被部下德基乌斯逼迫退位并杀害

summary.zh: 罗马皇帝阿拉伯人菲利普派德基乌斯（Decius）去多瑙河平定叛乱，但德基乌斯被军队拥立为帝。菲利普率军迎战，在维罗纳战役中兵败被杀。德基乌斯成为罗马皇帝，他出身伊利里亚行省，是第一位在蛮族入侵浪潮中崛起的军人皇帝。

statement.zh: 罗马皇帝阿拉伯人菲利普派德基乌斯（Decius）去多瑙河平定叛乱，但德基乌斯被军队拥立为帝。菲利普率军迎战，在维罗纳战役中兵败被杀。德基乌斯成为罗马皇帝，他出身伊利里亚行省，是第一位在蛮族入侵浪潮中崛起的军人皇帝。
statement.en:
Philip the Arab sent Decius to suppress a rebellion on the Danube, but Decius was proclaimed emperor by the troops. Philip led his army to meet him but was killed at the Battle of Verona. Decius became Roman emperor. He was an Illyrian provincial and the first soldier‑emperor to rise amid the barbarian invasions.

For Europe in 244 CE, “Roman emperor Philip the Arab is forced to abdicate and killed by his subordinate Decius” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 罗马皇帝德基乌斯战死在阿伯里图斯战役中

summary.zh: 德基乌斯率军征讨入侵的哥特人，在多瑙河下游的阿伯里图斯沼泽地带被哥特人包围。罗马军队陷入泥沼，无法有效组织阵型。德基乌斯和他的儿子赫伦尼乌斯一同战死，成为第一位在对外战争中战死的罗马皇帝。哥特人从此更加肆无忌惮地侵袭罗马。

statement.zh: 德基乌斯率军征讨入侵的哥特人，在多瑙河下游的阿伯里图斯沼泽地带被哥特人包围。罗马军队陷入泥沼，无法有效组织阵型。德基乌斯和他的儿子赫伦尼乌斯一同战死，成为第一位在对外战争中战死的罗马皇帝。哥特人从此更加肆无忌惮地侵袭罗马。
statement.en:
Decius led his army against the invading Goths and was trapped with his army in the swamps of Abritus on the lower Danube, unable to form a proper battle line. Decius and his son Herennius Etruscus were both killed, making him the first Roman emperor to die fighting a foreign enemy. The Goths, emboldened, raided Roman territory even more freely.

For Europe in 246 CE, “Roman emperor Decius is killed at the Battle of Abritus” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 罗马将领加卢斯继位，向哥特人求和

summary.zh: 德基乌斯战死后，罗马军队拥立加卢斯（Gallus）为帝。加卢斯立即与哥特人议和，允许哥特人带走战利品并每年向哥特人支付贡金。屈辱的求和进一步削弱了罗马在边境的威信。

title.zh: 日本邪马台国女王壹与遣使入贡曹魏

summary.zh: 邪马台国女王卑弥呼去世后，国中一度内战，立卑弥呼宗女壹与为王。壹与派出使节至曹魏洛阳朝贡，献上白珠、青玉等特产。魏国授予壹与官职和印信。此后邪马台国与中国的官方交往逐渐减少。

statement.zh: 邪马台国女王卑弥呼去世后，国中一度内战，立卑弥呼宗女壹与为王。壹与派出使节至曹魏洛阳朝贡，献上白珠、青玉等特产。魏国授予壹与官职和印信。此后邪马台国与中国的官方交往逐渐减少。
statement.en:
After the death of Queen Himiko of Yamatai, there was a civil war. She was succeeded by her relative Yi‑yo. Yi‑yo sent envoys to Luoyang, offering white pearls and green jade. The Wei court granted her a title and seal. Thereafter, official contacts between Yamatai and China gradually diminished.

For Asia in 246 CE, “Queen Yi‑yo of Yamatai sends envoys to Cao Wei” is a traceable node of Diplomacy change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 哥特人再次越过多瑙河，入侵罗马巴尔干行省

title.zh: 罗马帝国爆发严重瘟疫，人口大量死亡

summary.zh: 在战乱和饥荒的同时，一场瘟疫席卷罗马帝国，可能是由从东方返回的军队带入。瘟疫在巴尔干和意大利蔓延，罗马城和各地军营人口锐减。皇帝加卢斯无力应对，帝国陷入更深的困境。

title.zh: 罗马举行建城千年庆典

summary.zh: 皇帝阿拉伯人菲利普在罗马举行盛大的建城千年庆典。依瓦罗推算，罗马建于公元前753年，至此恰满一千年。庆典连办数日，斗兽场中投入大批猛兽与角斗士，并铸发纪念币，铭以“永恒之罗马”。这是罗马帝国最后一次大规模的传统世纪祭；此后不过数年，帝国便坠入三世纪危机最深的动荡。

statement.zh: 皇帝阿拉伯人菲利普在罗马举行盛大的建城千年庆典。依瓦罗推算，罗马建于公元前753年，至此恰满一千年。庆典连办数日，斗兽场中投入大批猛兽与角斗士，并铸发纪念币，铭以“永恒之罗马”。这是罗马帝国最后一次大规模的传统世纪祭；此后不过数年，帝国便坠入三世纪危机最深的动荡。
statement.en:
In 248, the emperor Philip the Arab staged games in Rome to mark the city’s thousandth year: by Varro’s reckoning Rome had been founded in 753 BC, so the millennium fell now. The festivities ran for days, consuming great numbers of wild beasts and gladiators, and commemorative coins were struck with the legend “Roma Aeterna”. It was the last great traditional celebration of the empire; within a few years Rome had plunged into the worst of the third-century crisis.

For Europe in 248 CE, “Rome celebrates its thousandth year” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

The festivities ran for days, consuming great numbers of wild beasts and gladiators, and commemorative coins were struck with the legend “Roma Aeterna”. It was the last great traditional celebration of the empire; within a few years Rome had plunged into the worst of the third-century crisis.

title.zh: 罗马皇帝德基乌斯在阿伯里图斯战死后，军队拥立德西乌斯为帝

summary.zh: 德基乌斯战死后，罗马军心大乱，部分军队拥立军官德西乌斯（Decius，注意与德基乌斯同名但不同人）为帝。实际上历史记载较为混乱，这里指的是德基乌斯战死后加卢斯被拥立，而非德西乌斯。修正为：德基乌斯战死后，加卢斯继位。

statement.zh: 德基乌斯战死后，罗马军心大乱，部分军队拥立军官德西乌斯（Decius，注意与德基乌斯同名但不同人）为帝。实际上历史记载较为混乱，这里指的是德基乌斯战死后加卢斯被拥立，而非德西乌斯。修正为：德基乌斯战死后，加卢斯继位。
statement.en:
Emperor Decius was killed in battle against the Goths at Abrittus (modern Razgrad, Bulgaria) in June 251. After his death, the Roman army in Moesia proclaimed Trebonianus Gallus as emperor. Gallus quickly made peace with the Goths, allowing them to leave with their plunder, and then turned his attention to the plague and barbarian invasions that were devastating the empire. Decius was the first Roman emperor to be killed in battle by a foreign enemy.

For Europe in 249 CE, “After Emperor Decius dies at the Battle of Abrittus, the army proclaims Gallus as emperor” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 孙权因后宫之争废太子孙和，引发东吴内部动荡

summary.zh: 孙权晚年宠爱幼子孙亮及鲁王孙霸，太子孙和地位不稳。孙权听信谗言，废黜太子孙和，改立孙亮为太子。同时赐死孙霸。此次“二宫之争”导致东吴内部大臣分裂，陆逊、朱据等大臣被牵连。陆逊忧愤而死。东吴政局陷入混乱。

statement.en:
In his later years, Sun Quan doted on his youngest son Sun Liang and another son, Sun Ba, while the crown prince Sun He's position became precarious. Sun Quan, listening to slander, deposed Sun He and made Sun Liang crown prince, while also killing Sun Ba. This 'dispute of the two princes' split the court of Eastern Wu, drawing in such ministers as Lu Xun and Zhu Ju. Lu Xun died of anger. The political situation in Eastern Wu became chaotic.

title.zh: 魏国权臣司马懿病逝，追谥宣文侯

summary.zh: 司马懿在洛阳病逝，享年72岁。他是曹魏四朝元老，在高平陵之变后实际掌控魏国大权。其子司马师、司马昭继承其权力，最终完成以晋代魏的过程。司马懿被追谥为宣文侯，其孙司马炎称帝后追尊为宣皇帝。

statement.zh: 司马懿在洛阳病逝，享年72岁。他是曹魏四朝元老，在高平陵之变后实际掌控魏国大权。其子司马师、司马昭继承其权力，最终完成以晋代魏的过程。司马懿被追谥为宣文侯，其孙司马炎称帝后追尊为宣皇帝。
statement.en:
Sima Yi died of illness in Luoyang at the age of 72. He had served as a senior minister under four Wei emperors. After the Gaoping coup, he effectively controlled the Wei government. His sons Sima Shi and Sima Zhao inherited his power, eventually completing the transition from Wei to Jin. Sima Yi was posthumously honored as Marquis Xuanwen, and when his grandson Sima Yan became emperor, he was honored as Emperor Xuan of Jin.

For Asia in 251 CE, “Wei regent Sima Yi dies; posthumous title Xuanwen Hou” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

summary.zh: 瓦莱里安率军与萨珊波斯国王沙普尔一世在埃德萨附近交战。罗马军队因瘟疫和断粮大败，瓦莱里安试图谈判时被波斯人俘虏。沙普尔一世将瓦莱里安作为俘虏示众，在浮雕中描绘瓦莱里安向他跪拜。瓦莱里安后来死在波斯，成为罗马历史上第一位被敌人俘虏的皇帝。

statement.zh: 瓦莱里安率军与萨珊波斯国王沙普尔一世在埃德萨附近交战。罗马军队因瘟疫和断粮大败，瓦莱里安试图谈判时被波斯人俘虏。沙普尔一世将瓦莱里安作为俘虏示众，在浮雕中描绘瓦莱里安向他跪拜。瓦莱里安后来死在波斯，成为罗马历史上第一位被敌人俘虏的皇帝。
statement.en:
Valerian led his army against Sasanian Persian king Shapur I near Edessa. The Roman army, crippled by plague and shortage of supplies, was badly defeated. Valerian, trying to negotiate, was captured by the Persians. Shapur I displayed him as a captive, showing Valerian kneeling to him in rock reliefs. Valerian died in Persian captivity, the first Roman emperor to be captured by an enemy.

For Europe in 251 CE, “Roman emperor Valerian is routed in the east and captured by the Sasanian Persians” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

zh: 瓦莱里安率军与萨珊波斯国王沙普尔一世在埃德萨附近交战。罗马军队因瘟疫和断粮大败，瓦莱里安试图谈判时被波斯人俘虏。沙普尔一世将瓦莱里安作为俘虏示众，在浮雕中描绘瓦莱里安向他跪拜。瓦莱里安后来死在波斯，成为罗马历史上第一位被敌人俘虏的皇帝。

en: Valerian led his army against Sasanian Persian king Shapur I near Edessa. The Roman army, crippled by plague and shortage of supplies, was badly defeated. Valerian died in Persian captivity, the first Roman emperor to be captured by an enemy.

title.zh: 法兰克人入侵高卢，摧毁罗马边境防线

summary.zh: 法兰克人（Franks）是莱茵河下游的日耳曼部落联盟。他们趁罗马内乱，突破莱茵河防线，劫掠高卢北部，摧毁了科隆、特里尔等城市。罗马在高卢的统治受到严重威胁。

statement.zh: 法兰克人（Franks）是莱茵河下游的日耳曼部落联盟。他们趁罗马内乱，突破莱茵河防线，劫掠高卢北部，摧毁了科隆、特里尔等城市。罗马在高卢的统治受到严重威胁。
statement.en:
The Franks, a confederation of Germanic tribes from the lower Rhine, took advantage of the Roman civil war to break through the Rhine frontier, plundering northern Gaul and devastating cities such as Cologne and Trier. Roman rule in Gaul was severely threatened.

For Europe in 254 CE, “Franks invade Gaul, destroying Roman border defenses” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 司马师废黜皇帝曹芳，改立曹髦为帝

summary.zh: 魏帝曹芳与中书令李丰、太常夏侯玄密谋诛杀司马师，事泄。司马师杀死李丰、夏侯玄等，然后以太后名义废黜曹芳，贬为齐王。改立高贵乡公曹髦为帝（曹魏第四位皇帝）。司马师继续执掌朝政。

statement.zh: 魏帝曹芳与中书令李丰、太常夏侯玄密谋诛杀司马师，事泄。司马师杀死李丰、夏侯玄等，然后以太后名义废黜曹芳，贬为齐王。改立高贵乡公曹髦为帝（曹魏第四位皇帝）。司马师继续执掌朝政。
statement.en:
Wei emperor Cao Fang plotted with the Palace Attendant Li Feng and Grand Commandant Xiahou Xuan to kill Sima Shi. The plot was discovered. Sima Shi executed Li Feng, Xiahou Xuan, and others, then, in the name of the Empress Dowager, deposed Cao Fang, demoting him to Prince of Qi. He proclaimed the Duke of Gaogui, Cao Mao, as emperor (the fourth emperor of Cao Wei). Sima Shi continued to control the government.

For Asia in 254 CE, “Sima Shi deposes Emperor Cao Fang and installs Cao Mao as emperor” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 蜀汉姜维北伐，在狄道大破魏将王经

statement.zh: 姜维率数万军队北伐，魏国雍州刺史王经迎战。在洮西（今甘肃临洮），姜维大破魏军，魏军阵亡数万，王经退守狄道（今甘肃临洮）。魏国派陈泰、邓艾增援，姜维粮尽退兵。此战是姜维北伐中战果最大的一次。
statement.en:
Jiang Wei led several 10,000 of troops north. The Wei Inspector of Yongzhou, Wang Jing, met him in battle. At Taoxi (modern Lintao, Gansu), Jiang Wei inflicted a major defeat on the Wei army, with 10,000 killed. Wang Jing retreated to Didao (modern Lintao, Gansu). Wei sent Chen Tai and Deng Ai with reinforcements, and Jiang Wei withdrew when his supplies ran out. This was the most successful of Jiang Wei's northern expeditions.

statement.en:
Wei's General Who Guards the East, Guanqiu Jian, and Inspector of Yangzhou, Wen Qin, raised troops to overthrow Sima Shi. Despite being ill, Sima Shi personally led the campaign and crushed them. Guanqiu Jian was killed, and Wen Qin fled to Eastern Wu. Sima Shi died of illness on the way back to Xuchang. His brother Sima Zhao succeeded as Grand General, continuing to control the government.

title.zh: 高卢帝国在波斯图穆斯统治下巩固疆域，发行独立钱币

summary.zh: 波斯图穆斯在高卢建立起有效的行政管理，发行带有自己头像的金币。高卢帝国拥有强大的军团（大部分原莱茵河驻军），保护了高卢和不列颠免受蛮族侵袭，实际上比罗马中央政府更有效地守护了西部边境。

statement.zh: 波斯图穆斯在高卢建立起有效的行政管理，发行带有自己头像的金币。高卢帝国拥有强大的军团（大部分原莱茵河驻军），保护了高卢和不列颠免受蛮族侵袭，实际上比罗马中央政府更有效地守护了西部边境。
statement.en:
Postumus established effective administration in Gaul and issued gold coins bearing his own portrait. The Gallic Empire possessed strong legions (most of the former Rhine garrisons), which protected Gaul and Britain from barbarian incursions. In fact, it defended the western frontier more effectively than the central Roman government.

For Europe in 257 CE, “The Gallic Empire, under Postumus, consolidates its territory and issues its own coinage” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: 约258年，波斯图穆斯在高卢自立为帝，与伽列努斯对抗；他守住莱茵边境，极盛时统治高卢、不列颠和西班牙，268年死于兵变。
statement.en: About 258 CE Postumus set himself up as an independent emperor in Gaul and became a rival of Gallienus; he defended the Rhine frontier, ruled Gaul, Britain, and Spain at his height, and was killed in 268.

sources.locator: Opening paragraph
sources.excerpt: Marcus Cassianius Latinius Postumus (died 268) was a Roman general who, by setting himself up as an independent emperor in Gaul about 258–268, became a rival to the emperor Gallienus. ... Postumus successfully defended the Rhine frontier and withstood Gallienus’ attempts to recover Gaul (265). At the height of his power, he ruled Gaul, Britain, and Spain. ... Postumus was killed in a mutiny of the legion of Mogontiacum.

note.en: The source dates Postumus's independent emperorship in Gaul to about 258–268, records his defence of the Rhine frontier and rule over Gaul, Britain, and Spain, and his death in 268; it does not support the body's 257 CE date, administrative system, or independent coinage, so the claim omits them.

statement.en:
Sima Zhao personally led 260,000 troops to surround Shouchun. After months of siege, the city ran out of food. Zhuge Dan killed Wen Qin, causing an internal collapse. The Wu relief force was also defeated. When the city fell, Zhuge Dan was killed and his three clans were exterminated. With the three Huainan rebellions now fully suppressed, Sima Zhao eliminated all internal opposition in Cao Wei.

For Asia in 258 CE, “Sima Zhao, after a long siege, captures Shouchun and kills Zhuge Dan” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 魏帝曹髦密谋诛杀司马昭，召集侍中王沈、尚书王经等谋划

summary.zh: 曹髦不甘做傀儡，与侍中王沈、尚书王经等商议，准备突袭司马昭府邸。王沈、王业向司马昭告密，曹髦只得孤注一掷。

statement.zh:
曹髦不甘做傀儡，与侍中王沈、尚书王经等商议，准备突袭司马昭府邸。王沈、王业向司马昭告密，曹髦只得孤注一掷。密谋暴露后，皇帝亲自率众出击，权力斗争转为公开冲突；告密者以情报换取新朝的信任。此事成为魏晋禅代的转折点。

把「魏帝曹髦密谋诛杀司马昭，召集侍中王沈、尚书王经等谋划」放回公元259年的曹魏，可以看到政治变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Unwilling to remain a puppet, Cao Mao met with the Palace Attendant Wang Shen, Minister Wang Jing, and others to plan a surprise attack on Sima Zhao's mansion.

title.zh: 罗马皇帝加里恩努斯忙于应对各地危机，无暇东顾，哥特人肆虐巴尔干

summary.zh: 加里恩努斯在任内主要对抗高卢帝国和蛮族，哥特人乘机大规模入侵巴尔干，一直打到爱琴海沿岸。罗马军队兵力分散，无法有效反击。

statement.zh: 加里恩努斯在任内主要对抗高卢帝国和蛮族，哥特人乘机大规模入侵巴尔干，一直打到爱琴海沿岸。罗马军队兵力分散，无法有效反击。
statement.en:
Gallienus spent most of his reign fighting the Gallic Empire and barbarians. The Goths took advantage to invade the Balkans on a large scale, reaching the Aegean coast. The Roman army, with its forces dispersed, could not mount an effective counterattack.

For Europe in 260 CE, “Roman emperor Gallienus, busy with crises everywhere, neglects the east; Goths ravage the Balkans” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 司马昭在曹髦被杀后立曹奂为帝

summary.zh: 曹髦率数百僮仆出宫讨伐司马昭，在宫门口被司马昭部将贾充指使成济刺死。司马昭为平息众怒，处死成济三族，并以太后名义贬曹髦为庶人。随后立曹奂（曹操之孙）为帝，即魏元帝。司马昭完全掌控曹魏政权。

statement.zh: 曹髦率数百僮仆出宫讨伐司马昭，在宫门口被司马昭部将贾充指使成济刺死。司马昭为平息众怒，处死成济三族，并以太后名义贬曹髦为庶人。随后立曹奂（曹操之孙）为帝，即魏元帝。司马昭完全掌控曹魏政权。
statement.en:
Cao Mao led several hundred retainers out of the palace to attack Sima Zhao. At the Southern Gate of the palace, Sima Zhao's subordinate Jia Chong ordered Cheng Ji to stab Cao Mao to death. To calm public outcry, Sima Zhao executed Cheng Ji and his three clans and, in the name of the Empress Dowager, demoted Cao Mao to commoner. Then he proclaimed Cao Huan (a grandson of Cao Cao) as emperor, Emperor Yuan of Wei. Sima Zhao now completely controlled the Cao Wei government.

For Asia in 260 CE, “After Cao Mao is killed, Sima Zhao installs Cao Huan as emperor” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 魏帝曹髦率军讨伐司马昭，被成济刺杀于南阙

summary.zh: 曹髦不堪忍受司马昭的专权，拔剑登辇，率领宫中僮仆数百人攻打司马昭府邸。在宫南阙下，司马昭部将贾充令成济将曹髦刺死。这一弑君事件震动朝野，司马昭为缓解舆论，杀死成济并夷三族。这是魏晋禅代前最严重的一次公开冲突。

statement.zh: 曹髦不堪忍受司马昭的专权，拔剑登辇，率领宫中僮仆数百人攻打司马昭府邸。在宫南阙下，司马昭部将贾充令成济将曹髦刺死。这一弑君事件震动朝野，司马昭为缓解舆论，杀死成济并夷三族。这是魏晋禅代前最严重的一次公开冲突。
statement.en:
Unable to endure Sima Zhao's domination any longer, Cao Mao drew his sword, mounted his chariot, and led several hundred retainers to attack Sima Zhao's mansion. At the Southern Gate of the palace, Jia Chong ordered Cheng Ji to kill Cao Mao. This regicide shook the court and the country. To ease the backlash, Sima Zhao had Cheng Ji executed with his three clans. This was the most serious open confrontation before the Wei–Jin transition.

For Asia in 260 CE, “Wei emperor Cao Mao leads troops against Sima Zhao and is killed at the Southern Gate” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: “越名教而任自然”并非否定秩序，而是质疑以名分礼法压抑人的本性，主张让行为回到自然的尺度；论养生谈形神与节欲，论音乐则辨析声音本身并无哀乐，情感来自听者。
statement.en: To transcend the teaching of names and follow nature was not a rejection of order but a challenge to conventions that suppress human character, arguing that conduct should return to a natural measure; his essay on nurturing life treats body and spirit and the restraint of desire, while the essay on music argues that sound itself carries no sorrow or joy and that feeling comes from the listener.

title.zh: 罗马皇帝克劳狄二世病逝，奥勒良继位，开始统一帝国

summary.zh: 克劳狄二世在战胜哥特人后因病去世，其骑兵统帅奥勒良（Aurelian）被军队拥立为帝。奥勒良是伊利里亚军人出身，意志坚定，他在位五年间收复了高卢帝国和帕尔米拉王国，重建了统一的罗马帝国。

statement.zh: 克劳狄二世在战胜哥特人后因病去世，其骑兵统帅奥勒良（Aurelian）被军队拥立为帝。奥勒良是伊利里亚军人出身，意志坚定，他在位五年间收复了高卢帝国和帕尔米拉王国，重建了统一的罗马帝国。
statement.en:
Claudius II died of illness after defeating the Goths. His cavalry commander Aurelian was proclaimed emperor by the army. Aurelian, an Illyrian officer of strong will, in his five‑year reign reconquered the Gallic Empire and the Palmyrene kingdom, reuniting the Roman Empire.

For Europe in 262 CE, “Roman emperor Claudius II dies of illness; Aurelian succeeds, beginning the reunification of the empire” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 邓艾偷渡阴平，灭亡蜀汉

summary.zh: 魏国三路大军伐蜀，姜维将钟会主力阻挡在剑阁。邓艾率万余精兵自阴平（今甘肃文县）沿无人小道攀爬山谷，凿山开路，直抵江油（今四川江油）。蜀汉守将马邈投降。邓艾长驱直入，在绵竹击败诸葛瞻父子，兵临成都。后主刘禅出降，蜀汉灭亡。

statement.zh: 魏国三路大军伐蜀，姜维将钟会主力阻挡在剑阁。邓艾率万余精兵自阴平（今甘肃文县）沿无人小道攀爬山谷，凿山开路，直抵江油（今四川江油）。蜀汉守将马邈投降。邓艾长驱直入，在绵竹击败诸葛瞻父子，兵临成都。后主刘禅出降，蜀汉灭亡。
statement.en:
The three Wei armies attacked Shu. Jiang Wei blocked Zhong Hui's main force at Jiange. Deng Ai led over 10,000 elite troops along the Yinping shortcut (modern Wen County, Gansu), climbing over mountains and cutting roads, reaching Jiangyou (modern Jiangyou, Sichuan). The Shu defender Ma Miao surrendered. Deng Ai then advanced to Mianzhu, where he killed Zhuge Zhan, and then pressed on to Chengdu. The Later Lord Liu Shan surrendered, and Shu Han fell.

For Asia in 263 CE, “Deng Ai takes the Yinping shortcut and destroys Shu Han” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 魏国伐蜀，邓艾出阴平小道，钟会出斜谷，三路攻蜀

summary.zh: 司马昭以钟会、邓艾、诸葛绪分三路伐蜀。钟会牵制姜维于剑阁，邓艾则率精兵从阴平小道翻越雪山，奇袭江油，直逼成都。蜀汉防线崩溃。

statement.en:
Sima Zhao ordered Zhong Hui, Deng Ai, and Zhuge Xu to attack Shu in three columns. Zhong Hui tied down Jiang Wei at Jiange. Deng Ai took a force of elite troops over the Yinping shortcut, crossing snowy mountains, and surprised Jiangyou, then marched directly on Chengdu. The Shu defensive line collapsed.

summary.zh: 吴景帝孙休病逝，其子年幼。丞相濮阳兴、左将军张布迎立孙休的侄子孙皓为帝。孙皓即位初期尚能勤政，但很快暴露残暴本性，诛杀大臣，沉迷酒色，导致东吴国力急遽衰落。

statement.zh: 吴景帝孙休病逝，其子年幼。丞相濮阳兴、左将军张布迎立孙休的侄子孙皓为帝。孙皓即位初期尚能勤政，但很快暴露残暴本性，诛杀大臣，沉迷酒色，导致东吴国力急遽衰落。
statement.en:
Emperor Jing of Wu, Sun Xiu, died of illness. His son was young. The Chancellor Puyang Xing and the General of the Left Zhang Bu welcomed Sun Xiu's nephew Sun Hao as emperor. Initially, Sun Hao governed diligently, but he soon revealed his brutal nature, executing ministers and indulging in wine and women, causing Eastern Wu's national strength to decline rapidly.

In 264 CE, “Sun Hao of Eastern Wu ascends the throne, known as the Last Emperor of Wu” belongs to the field of Politics in Asia.

title.zh: 司马炎大封宗室二十七王，允许诸王拥有军队，埋下八王之乱隐患

summary.zh: 晋武帝司马炎为巩固司马氏统治，将司马氏宗室二十七人封为王，并给予封地和军队。诸王不仅享有食邑，还掌握地方军政大权，后来成为“八王之乱”的制度根源。

statement.zh: 晋武帝司马炎为巩固司马氏统治，将司马氏宗室二十七人封为王，并给予封地和军队。诸王不仅享有食邑，还掌握地方军政大权，后来成为“八王之乱”的制度根源。
statement.en:
To consolidate the Sima clan's rule, Emperor Wu of Jin enfeoffed twenty‑seven members of the Sima imperial house as kings, granting them fiefdoms and armies. The kings not only received revenues from their lands but also held military and civilian authority in their territories. This system became the institutional root of the later 'War of the Eight Princes'.

For Asia in 265 CE, “Sima Yan enfeoffs twenty‑seven imperial clan members as kings, allowing them to maintain armies, planting the seeds of the War of the Eight Princes” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 罗马皇帝克劳狄二世（哥特征服者）率军大败哥特人于纳伊苏斯

summary.zh: 哥特人集结数万大军入侵巴尔干，克劳狄二世率领罗马军队在纳伊苏斯（今塞尔维亚尼什）进行决定性会战。罗马军利用骑兵侧翼突击，歼灭哥特军三万余人，缴获大量物资。哥特人被赶过多瑙河，数年不敢南侵。克劳狄二世因此被元老院授予“哥特征服者”称号。

statement.zh: 哥特人集结数万大军入侵巴尔干，克劳狄二世率领罗马军队在纳伊苏斯（今塞尔维亚尼什）进行决定性会战。罗马军利用骑兵侧翼突击，歼灭哥特军三万余人，缴获大量物资。哥特人被赶过多瑙河，数年不敢南侵。克劳狄二世因此被元老院授予“哥特征服者”称号。
statement.en:
The Goths assembled 10,000 of men to invade the Balkans. Claudius II led the Roman army to a decisive battle at Naissus (modern Niš, Serbia). Using a cavalry flank attack, the Romans killed over 30,000 Goths and captured a huge amount of booty. The Goths were driven back across the Danube and did not dare raid for several years. For this, the Senate granted Claudius II the title 'Gothicus'.

For Europe in 268 CE, “Roman emperor Claudius II (Gothicus) decisively defeats the Goths at Naissus” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 萨珊波斯沙普尔一世去世，其子霍尔米兹德一世继位

summary.zh: 沙普尔一世（Shapur I）在位约30年，是萨珊王朝的征服者。他击败罗马，俘虏瓦莱里安，向东征服贵霜，使萨珊达到鼎盛。他死后，其子霍尔米兹德一世（Hormizd I）继位，但统治时间很短。

statement.zh: 沙普尔一世（Shapur I）在位约30年，是萨珊王朝的征服者。他击败罗马，俘虏瓦莱里安，向东征服贵霜，使萨珊达到鼎盛。他死后，其子霍尔米兹德一世（Hormizd I）继位，但统治时间很短。
statement.en:
Shapur I reigned for about 30 years and was the conqueror of the Sasanian dynasty. He defeated Rome, captured Valerian, and conquered the Kushans in the east, bringing the Sasanian Empire to its zenith. After his death, his son Hormizd I succeeded, but his reign was short.

For Asia in 269 CE, “Shapur I of Sasanian Persia dies; his son Hormizd I succeeds” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

summary.zh: 鉴于3世纪危机期间蛮族曾兵临罗马城下，奥勒良下令修建一道环绕罗马的砖石城墙，全长约19公里，有18座城门和数百座塔楼。奥勒良城墙成为罗马城此后一千多年的主要防御工事。

title.zh: 蜀汉后主刘禅在洛阳去世，谥号思公

summary.zh: 刘禅被迁往洛阳后，被封为安乐公，食邑万户。他在洛阳生活安逸，留下了“此间乐，不思蜀”的典故。刘禅病逝于洛阳，谥号思公。西晋以公爵之礼葬之。

statement.zh: 刘禅被迁往洛阳后，被封为安乐公，食邑万户。他在洛阳生活安逸，留下了“此间乐，不思蜀”的典故。刘禅病逝于洛阳，谥号思公。西晋以公爵之礼葬之。
statement.en:
After being moved to Luoyang, Liu Shan was made Duke of Anle (the Happy Duke), with a fief of 10,000 households. He lived a comfortable life in Luoyang, giving rise to the phrase 'Happy here, I don't think of Shu.' Liu Shan died of illness in Luoyang, with the posthumous title Duke Si. The Western Jin buried him with ducal rites.

For Asia in 271 CE, “Liu Shan, Later Lord of Shu Han, dies in Luoyang; posthumous title Duke Si” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

summary.zh: 帕尔米拉在投降后不久再次反叛，奥勒良派军镇压，彻底摧毁了帕尔米拉城的防御工事，掠夺其财富。帕尔米拉从此失去独立地位。芝诺比阿被囚禁于罗马。

statement.en:
Palmyra rebelled again soon after its first surrender. Aurelian sent troops to suppress it, thoroughly destroying the city's fortifications and looting its wealth. Palmyra lost its independence forever. Zenobia was imprisoned in Rome.

For Europe in 273 CE, “After Palmyra surrenders, the Roman army completely destroys the city” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

summary.zh: 努梅里安在行军途中病逝（一说被杀），其近卫军长官戴克里先（Diocletian）被军队拥立为帝。戴克里先迅速击败了对手卡里努斯，统一罗马。他后来推行一系列改革，结束了三世纪危机。

statement.zh: 努梅里安在行军途中病逝（一说被杀），其近卫军长官戴克里先（Diocletian）被军队拥立为帝。戴克里先迅速击败了对手卡里努斯，统一罗马。他后来推行一系列改革，结束了三世纪危机。
statement.en:
Numerian died (or was killed) on the march. His Praetorian prefect, Diocletian, was proclaimed emperor by the army. Diocletian quickly defeated his rival Carinus, reuniting the empire. He later carried out a series of reforms that ended the Crisis of the Third Century.

For Europe in 273 CE, “Roman emperor Numerian dies; Diocletian is proclaimed emperor by the army, initiating Rome's revival” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 戴克里先任命马克西米安为凯撒，负责帝国西部防务

statement.zh: 戴克里先认识到帝国需要多人共治，他任命好友马克西米安（Maximian）为凯撒（副帝），负责高卢、不列颠和西班牙的防务。马克西米安迅速平定了高卢的农民起义（巴高达运动），稳固了西部。
statement.en:
Diocletian realized that the empire needed multiple rulers. He appointed his friend Maximian as Caesar (junior emperor) to be responsible for Gaul, Britain, and Spain. Maximian quickly suppressed the Bagaudae (peasant uprising) in Gaul, stabilizing the west.

title.zh: 罗马皇帝普罗布斯肃清多瑙河下游蛮族

summary.zh: 公元278年，罗马皇帝普罗布斯在多瑙河下游连续用兵，击败入侵的哥特人、汪达尔人与萨尔马提亚人，夺回被掳掠的人口与牲畜，并把部分归降的蛮族迁入巴尔干和小亚细亚屯垦。此前奥勒良已在270年代放弃多瑙河北岸的达契亚行省，把行政建制南移至河南岸新设的"奥勒良达契亚"。普罗布斯的战役暂时稳定了帝国的多瑙河防线，也标志着三世纪危机趋于缓解。

title.zh: 西晋发六路大军二十余万，水陆并进，发动灭吴之战

summary.zh: 晋武帝下令分六路伐吴：镇东大将军司马伷出涂中；安东将军王浑出江西；建威将军王戎出武昌；平南将军胡奋出夏口；镇南大将军杜预出江陵；龙骧将军王濬、唐彬率巴蜀水军顺流东下。总兵力超过二十万，是晋吴之间规模最大的一次决战。

statement.en: Emperor Wu of Jin ordered a six‑pronged attack on Wu: Sima You (Grand General Who Guards the East) from Tuzhong; Wang Hun (General Who Pacifies the East) from Jiangxi; Wang Rong (General Who Builds the Army) from Wuchang; Hu Fen (General Who Pacifies the South) from Xiakou; Du Yu (Grand General Who Pacifies the South) from Jiangling; and Wang Jun and Tang Bin, with the Yizhou navy, sailing down the Yangtze.

title.zh: 西晋水陆并进，攻陷建业，东吴灭亡，三国终归一统

summary.zh: 王濬水师自益州顺流而下，攻克东吴在长江设置的铁锁铁锥防线，与杜预、王浑等陆军会合。东吴丞相张悌率军迎战，兵败身死。晋军兵临建业城下，孙皓仿效刘禅，反绑双手，抬着棺材出降。东吴灭亡，自208年赤壁之战开始的分裂局面，历经72年后重归统一。晋武帝封孙皓为归命侯。

statement.zh: 王濬水师自益州顺流而下，攻克东吴在长江设置的铁锁铁锥防线，与杜预、王浑等陆军会合。东吴丞相张悌率军迎战，兵败身死。晋军兵临建业城下，孙皓仿效刘禅，反绑双手，抬着棺材出降。东吴灭亡，自208年赤壁之战开始的分裂局面，历经72年后重归统一。晋武帝封孙皓为归命侯。
statement.en:
Wang Jun's navy sailed down from Yizhou, broke through the iron chains and stakes that Wu had placed across the Yangtze, and joined up with Du Yu and Wang Hun. The Wu Chancellor Zhang Ti led his troops to meet them but was defeated and killed. The Jin army reached Jianye. Sun Hao, imitating Liu Shan, tied his hands, carried a coffin, and surrendered. Eastern Wu was destroyed. The era of division that had begun with the Battle of Red Cliffs in 208 came to an end after 72 years of reunification. Emperor Wu of Jin granted Sun Hao the title of Marquis of Guiming.

For Asia in 280 CE, “Western Jin advances by land and water, captures Jianye, and ends Eastern Wu; the Three Kingdoms are finally unified” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 王叔和编《脉经》

summary.zh: 魏晋医家王叔和整理脉学，撰《脉经》，首次系统归纳二十四脉象，奠定中医诊断基础。

statement.zh: 魏晋医家王叔和整理脉学，撰《脉经》，首次系统归纳二十四脉象，奠定中医诊断基础。此前脉诊的记述散见于各家，名目与说法并不统一；《脉经》把脉象分类、指下感觉与主病联系起来，使诊脉成为可以教授和复核的技术。脉诊与望、闻、问并列，构成中医四诊的核心，后世的脉学著作多以此书为起点。
statement.en: The Wei-Jin physician Wang Shuhe systematised pulse lore into the Pulse Classic, the first systematic account of 24 pulse patterns in Chinese diagnostics.

title.zh: 西晋汲郡古墓出土《竹书纪年》等大批战国竹简

summary.zh: 西晋汲郡（今河南汲县）一个盗墓者挖开战国魏襄王（一说魏安釐王）的墓，发现大批竹简。晋武帝命荀勖、和峤等整理，共得竹书数十车，包括《竹书纪年》《穆天子传》《易经》等珍贵古籍。这批竹简记录了夏商周至战国时期的历史，其中《竹书纪年》许多记载与传世文献不同，具有极高史料价值。

statement.zh: 西晋汲郡（今河南汲县）一个盗墓者挖开战国魏襄王（一说魏安釐王）的墓，发现大批竹简。晋武帝命荀勖、和峤等整理，共得竹书数十车，包括《竹书纪年》《穆天子传》《易经》等珍贵古籍。这批竹简记录了夏商周至战国时期的历史，其中《竹书纪年》许多记载与传世文献不同，具有极高史料价值。
statement.en:
A tomb robber opened the tomb of King Xiang of Wei (or King Anxi of Wei) of the Warring States period at Jijun (modern Ji County, Henan), discovering a large number of bamboo slips. Emperor Wu of Jin ordered Xun Xu, He Jiao, and others to collate the texts. They obtained dozens of cartloads, including the 'Bamboo Annals', 'The Legend of King Mu', the 'Book of Changes', and other precious ancient texts. These bamboo slips recorded history from the Xia, Shang, and Zhou down to the Warring States. The 'Bamboo Annals' has many passages differing from the received tradition and is of great historical value.

For Asia in 281 CE, “The Jijun tomb in Western Jin yields a large cache of Warring States bamboo slips, including the 'Bamboo Annals'” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: 太康年间，西晋政府鼓励农耕，兴修水利，减轻赋税。史载“天下无事，赋税平均，人咸安其业而乐其事”。这一时期也是西晋文学（太康文学）的活跃期，左思、陆机、陆云、潘岳等文人辈出。
statement.en:
During the Taikang era, the Western Jin government encouraged farming, built water conservancy works, and reduced taxes. According to historical records, 'the realm was peaceful, taxes were fair, and the people were content with their work and happy in their professions.' This was also an active period for literature (Taikang literature), with writers such as Zuo Si, Lu Ji, Lu Yun, and Pan Yue.

For Asia in 282 CE, “The Taikang prosperity continues to develop under Western Jin, with a growing economy and population” is a traceable node of Economy change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 戴克里先对罗马帝国进行全面改革，包括行政、军事、财政

summary.zh: 戴克里先开始一系列改革：将行省数量从47个增加到近100个，加强对地方的控制；将骑兵从军团中分离，组建机动野战军；改革税制，以土地和人头为征税单位；发行新货币并颁布“物价敕令”。这些改革使罗马帝国重获稳定，但也强化了专制主义和官僚体系。

statement.en: Diocletian began a series of reforms: increasing the number of provinces from 47 to nearly 100 to strengthen local control; separating cavalry from the legions to form a mobile field army; reforming the tax system, taxing land and head; issuing new coinage and issuing the 'Edict on Maximum Prices'.
